tei:div.tei:p: "$ (429)༄༅// byang chub lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba la thog mar blo sbyong ba chos kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(430)༄༅// na mo bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gu ru bud+dha bodhi sa twa sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ hi ta su phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel zhing*/ khash+tsā ka ra bud+dha de sha war+dha ni/ pra rab tu rgyal par mdzad du gsol/ sa ra hu ku ru maṃ/ sarba sems can thams cad bde ba chen pos skyid pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ sa twa ñtsa ma hā su kha su khi ka ra ku ru maṃ/ ad+dhi tiṣ+ṭha tu māṃ byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba la thog mar blo sbyong ba chos kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang dbyer ma mchis pa bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'jig rten mes po mig stong ldan pa sogs// khams gsum gtso bos zhabs pad gus brten pas// dge legs kun thob bla ma lhar bcas la// gus pas btud de dam chos don gnyer can// snying nas chos sgrub rnams la brtse ba yis// dam chos sgrub tshul mdo dang bstan bcos dang*// bla ma rnams kyi gdams pas rab brgyan te// mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gdams pa bstan par bya// gus pas btud de rtse gcig yid kyis nyon// (431)skyes rabs su/ shi rta dag gis gang du sa la lam drangs pa// de bzhin gzhan dang gzhan yang lam der bskul te 'dong*// de ltar thog ma'i lam ni bde ba 'di bor nas// yang dag ma yin lam du 'jug par bdag mi dga'/ zhes 'og nas 'chad pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam la blo sbyong ba 'di med na/ gzhan gang la yang dga' ba'i gnas med pas thog mar blo sbyong tshul 'di med mi rung du gal che ba gsungs pa ltar thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs/ lung rig mngon sum thams cad kyis grub pa 'di nyid bshad par bya ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/

dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir snying po ci lon cig bya dgos/ de la yang nged rang gi mno bsam dang phyugs kyi mno bsam la khyad par ci 'dug lta dgos pa yin/ phyug la'ang ma 'khyags pa dang*/ ma ltogs pa skyid pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i bsam mno btang ba yod/ nged rang la'ang de las med na/ phyugs dang khyad par ma byung ba yin pas/ snying po len pa gal che gsungs/ de la snying po len pa la thogs mar tshe 'di la ma chags pa zhig dgos te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// dad pa (432)mang du byed pa yis// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// tshe 'di'i rnyed bskung dang snyan grags la sogs pa'i bde skyid kyi 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes// 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ zhes gsungs/ jo jo bo rje ni bo rje lha cig skyes bu dam pa de sku 'da' khar rnal 'byor pa chags khri mchog gis/ jo bo gshegs pa na/ bdag gi sdom par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin bor la thong gsungs// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul brnyes/ yi dam mang pos rjes su bzung ba sogs yon tan brjod kyis mi lang*/ rgya bod bal gsum na gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ bod du lo bcu bdun bzhugs// yongs rdzogs bdun bcu don gsum bzhugs so// jo bo'i bu chen rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta sa'i snying po/ rgyal po na yab la sogs mang*/ bod na khu rdog 'brom gsum dgon pa ba dang bzhi/ rnal 'byor pa byang chub rin chen/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje/ rnal 'byor pa chag khri mchog /rnal 'byor pa phyag dar ston pa ste bzhi/ dgon pa ba dang byang chub rin chen gnyis kyi rwa sbreng gi gud nas mdzad/ gzhan yang*/

lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ lo chen rin bzang*/ rgya brtson seng*/ nag tsho ba/ rma lo tsā ba dge blo/ zhang yer bang*/ rin chen bla ma sogs mang ngo*// de rnams kyi yon tan mtha' yas pa rang gi rnam thar na gsal/ ram sding ma ba'i rnam thar sogs las/ jo bo dang po to ba/ ram sding ma ba yang sprul pa nyid du gsungs/ mdo sde rnams las sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa bsam las 'das pa 'ongs par gsungs/ sku'i yon tan mtha' yas sprul sku zhig kyang yin te 'ong*/ de min na sprul sku mi srid par 'gyur ro// 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na res bshad res sgom mam zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci bgyi zhus pas/ tshe 'di blos thong gsungs/ khong (433)gis de thugs la bzhag nas/ rwa sgreng gi shug gseb na phar ri dwags rnams dang khyad par med par bzhugs nas mi su gang dang yang dgong 'phrad pa tsam yang ma mdzad par sku tshe 'da' ru bcug skad/ 'di mi la'i sku skye sngon ma yin par rgod tshang pa'i rnam thar las gsungs/ btsun pa gcig gis/ dgon par bskor ba byas pas/ ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ jo bo bskor ba byed pa'ang glo ba gda' ste/ de bas kyang chos shig rang byas na dga' gsungs/ kho'i bsam pa la/ phyag cig byas na dga' ba yin nam snyam nas byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ de bzhin du kha ton dang bsgom byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci bgyi lags zhus pas/ tshe 'di blos thong zhig lan gsum gsungs/ ston pa rin po che 'di 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad thugs kyis spangs nas yod pa la/ rong du gser mdun la spyan drangs pas/ dpal gyi dbang phyugs bya ba la bod par mdzad nas/ da lan 'di la khyod song dang*/ ngas 'jig rten blos gtong blo byas pas mi yong par 'dug gsungs nas/ na bza' re ral rnying pa zhig gsol/ res bem zhig gsol/ phrag pa gnyis phud/ phu thung gnyis phrag pa g.yas g.yon la bkal nas/

res 'ga' shug gseb na phar gshegs/ res 'ga' sba 'khar gcig yod pa la om tshugs mdzad nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshes springs las gsungs pa'i/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang*// bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang*// bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po// bdag gi yid yul min par 'go snyoms mdzod/ ces dang*/ res 'ga'/ bdag ni grol ba don gnyer la// rnyed dang bkur stis 'ching mi dgos/ zhes pa de tshang ba re/ res 'gro 'bud tsam re/ res phyed tsam re(434)dpung gin ldog ldog bzhugs/ khong la de dgos shad mi gda' ste rjes 'jug la slob pa yin gsungs/ spyan snga ba yang tshigs bcad de gsung gin chos brgyad 'go snyoms/ des na tshe 'di bden dga'/ sdug na mi dga' ba la sogs kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ bya byed thams cad dug bzhin du spangs bar bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ las dge mi dge ni sems kho na'i byed las yin/ lus ngag gi las tsam po lung ma bstan yin pas/ de'i tshe tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang*/ snyan grags dang*/ rnyed bskur 'dod pa dang*// sdug bsngal dang mi snyan pa dang*/ rnyed bskur ma byung ba mi 'dod pas/ bya byed thams cad ni 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te byas pa yin pas/ las mi dge ba shas che la/ de ltar na des kun nas bslangs pa'i so nam dang*/ tshong dang bun skyed dang*/ 'thab rtsod dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang*/ thos bsam sgom sgrub sogs kyi byas pa thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu kho nar 'gyur bas so// de ltar yang ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste// yid mgyogs yid ni gtso bo yin// ji ltar yid rab gdug pa yis// smras sam yang na byas kyang rung*// de yis de ni sdug bsngal thob// 'khor los mgo bo bcad pa bzhin// ji ltar yid rab dwangs ba yis// smras sam yang na byas kyang rung*// de yis de ni bde ba thob// grib ma rjes su 'brang ba bzhin/

zhes yid gdug pa dug gsum gyis byas pas sdug bsngal 'byung ste/ sprang po gnyis las gcig gis dge 'dun 'di rnams kyi rke 'khor los bcad par bya ba zhig na zhes khros te smras pas/ ring por ma thogs par lam gyi 'gram du nyal bar shing rta'i 'khor los mgo bo bcad/ gcig po des dge 'dun la sems dwang (435)bas/ 'di rnams lha yi bdud rtsis mchod du yod na a byas pas bsod nams chen po skyes nas/ snga dro nyal ba'i shing grib kyis phyi dro'ang ma btang bas tshong dpon chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas so// gzhan yang spyir bsams gzhig nas srog gcod pa ni phal cher la sdig pa yin yang ded dpon snying rje chen pos mi bsad pa/ snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pas sdig tu ma song ba'i khar tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs khyad par can du song ba la sogs bu chos las mang du gsungs shing 'jig rten na'ang bltas na shes par snang ste/ brnyas thabs kyis bza' btung sogs byin na ni dga' ba med pa'i khar mi dga' ba 'ong bar snang*/ dad gus sam snying rje sogs kyis byin na ni dga' tshor gzhan pas che ba byed par snang ba de yin/ des na thams cad sems kyi khyad du snang bas/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid la 'dod pa ma skyes pa dang*/ skyes na yang 'bad pas spong ba zhig gal tsha ba der gda'/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang*/ rtsa ba dug yin na yal ga dang lo ma'ang dug rtsa ba sman yin na yal ga dang lo ma'ang sman du yod pa bzhin du/ rtsa ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la ci byas mi dge ba yin gsungs/ dge bshes ston pas ston pa rin po che/ byang na tar ram rtsa skyer sku 'khrungs/ jo bo rje lo ngo bco brgyad bsten/ sgrol mas skyes bu dam pa bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan/ lung rtogs ting nge 'dzin yi dam zhal gzigs mtha' yas shing bla mas btsun sogs las sde snod thugs spyod rgya cher mdzad/

rwa sgreng btab/ sku ched gsum sogs bu chen mang du byon/ bka' gdams byings khong las mched rwa sgreng btab nas lo bdun bzhugs/ khyon dgong lo re gcig bzhugs so/ /a ti shal tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang rnyed bkur sogs 'dod nas las byas pa rnams la 'bras bu ci mchis zhus pas/ 'bras bu de kho na nyid mchis gsungs/ tshe phyi ma la ci mchis zhus pas/ dmyal ba 'chi/ (436)yi dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs/ dge bshes dgon pa ba'i bu chen bzhi'i ya gyal/ mtshan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'khrungs yul khams rus 'dzongs yin/ dgung lo bdun bcu nye/ ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon shes sogs yon tan mtha' yas/ rwa sgreng gi gdan sa mdzad/ bu chen dgon pa ba'i bu bzhi ni/ bla ma sne zur pa/ 'the kod de lung pa/ snyan sna mo ba dang bzhi'o/ gzhan yang kha rag sgom chung sogs mang ngo*/ zhal nas/ chos brgyad kyi bsam pas byas pa rnam la 'bras bu 'dod pa bzhi ni rnyed bkur dang gcig /snyan grags dang gnyis/ bstod pa dang gsum/ bde skyid dang bzhi'o// byung na/ tshe 'di la 'bras bu de rang yin/ phyi mar phan pa med/ mi 'dod pa bzhi ni de las ldog phyogs bzhi'o// byung na tshe 'di rang la'ang phan pa med gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas kyang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags mi sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// zhes dang mdo las/ dkon mchog sprin/ 'jig rten sems kyis khrid pa ste// sems kyis sems ni mi mthong ngo*// dge ba'am 'on te sdig kyang rung*// las ni sems kyis gsog par byed/ ces dang spyod 'jug las// stag dang seng ge glang chen dred// sbrul dang dgra rnams thams cad dang*// sems can dmyal ba'i bsrung ma dang*// byad ma de bzhin srin po rnams// sems ni gcig pu btags pa yis// de dag thams cad btags par 'gyur// sems ni gcig pu btul ba yis// de dag thams cad btul bar 'gyur// gang gi chos kyi gtso bo mchog

/sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na// bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang*// de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams// sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// btul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs// des (437)na las gang byed kyang kun slong la brtag pa gal che ste/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum 'dod nas las so nam nas sgom sgrub kyi bar byed pa ni tshe 'di'i gang zag ces bya ba dud 'gro dang khyad med/ tshe phyi mar lha mi sogs 'dod nas chos sam 'jig rten byed pa ni skyes bu chung ngu zhes pa yin/ des las byas pa thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu kho na yin/ rang nyid 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod/ 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad las yid 'byung 'jigs shing skrag nas chos byed pa ni las dge ba 'khor ba las thar pa'i rgyu kho na yin/ de la skyes bu 'bring zhes bya/ rang thar pa tsam ma yin par sems can thams cad thar bar bya ba'i phyir byas pa thams cad ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin/ de la skyes bu chen po'am skyes bu mchog ces pa yin pas skyes bu che chung 'bring gsum yang sems kho na la 'jog pas/ sems la spang blangs bya zhing*/ dang po thog mar tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod thams cad spangs nas/ tshe blos gtong ba zhig chos pa thams cad kyis thog mar bya dgos so// 'di ma spangs par chos pa'i ming rang yong don med de/ sngar bshad pa ltar tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod kyis ci byas phal cher chos min kho na spyod par 'dug gi chos spyod par mi 'dug pas so// dper na rta la seng ge'i mtshan nyid med pas seng ge zhes mi brjod pa bzhin no// des na tshe blos btang 'di chos kyi 'go 'dzugs/ chos kyi dang po/ chos pa'i 'dun ma bshom pa'i snga shos dang po yin te/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ rgya ma ba mtshan bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dgyer gyi gdung brgyud/ gsang bu'i gling smad/ glang thang dang rgya ma rin chen sgang rnams kyi gdams mdzad/

mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes dang yon tan mtha' yas par grags/ g.yag sde paṇa chen sogs bu chen mang*/ sa skya'i chos 'chad kyang mdzad/ dgung lo re gnyis bzhugs so/ /chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub kyang*// khyod nyid (438)chos par rloms par kye ma blun// chos kyi dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa// rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ gsungs/ bla ma ye dgon pa'i zhal nas/ 'dir dbur stod kyi 'ol sna btab/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi bu chen yin no// da pha yul la zhen pa'i phyi thag bstungs// gnyen la gdong chung gi ltag ba ston// nor la chog shes kyi gnyen po bsten// 'di bya btang gi mdun gros dang po yin/ gsungs// des na sngar chos byas sam ma byas/ da chos yong ngam mi yong*// rang gi pha yul dang nye 'brel zas nor sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams blos btang dam ma btang la brtag par bya ste/ mar pa lots+tsha'i zhal nas/ bu 'jig rten 'di blos ma thongs par tshe 'di'i bya ba dang dam pa'i chos bsras na/ chos de shor zin pa de rang yin/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes// bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas// bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su// bshad kyang brjod kyis mi long ba// ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gson/ zhes rje btsun mi la yul du 'byon pa'i 'gro chos su gnang ba yin skad/

rje btsun gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ni rnam thar las gsal/ mtshan dngos thos pa dga' dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ khab gung thang ba/ grub pa brnyes/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs/ rgyal tshab gnyis ni/ dwags po lha rje dang*/ ras chung rdo rje grags so// bu chen pa rgyud 'dzin gtso bo ni dwags po lha rje/ thugs sras lnga ni/ ras chung rdo rje grags/ gnyan chung ras pa/ gtsan lung gi ngan rdzong ston pa/ rta mo'i 'bri sgom ras pa/ mdo bkra se ban ras ba'o// nye ba'i sras brgyad ni/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs/ ras pa rtsa phug /ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug /gshan sgom ras pa/ ras chung ras pa/ mkhar chu ras pa/ glang sgom ras pa'o// phyi'i ras pa drug ni/ li kor cha ru ba/ (439)'on ston dge 'dun/ skyo ston shā kya gu/ dam pa rgyags phug /se ben ston chung*/ 'bi bar bkra shis so// mgur 'di ras pa zhib 'od la gdams pa lags so// rje btsun mi las kyang*/ bu snying nas lha chos bya snyam na// dad pa gting nas skyes pa na// tshe 'di la phyi mig mi lta na// bden pa nga phyir 'brang ba na// gnyen 'dun bdud kyi gshol 'debs yin// bden no ma snyam 'khri ba chod// zas nor bdud kyi so pa yin// 'dris shing ngan no 'dzin chags spongs// 'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pa yin// 'ching bar nges so zhen pa thongs// gzhon grogs bdud kyi bu mo yin// bslu bar nges so khong zon gyis// pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin// thar bar bka' yis myur du bros// lar thams cad bzhag nas 'gro dgos na// dus da lta bzhag na don can lags// mi nga zer de tsho nyan spyod na// bu khyod la lha chos kyi skal ba yod/ gsungs/ dwags po lha rje'i rje dwags po'i mtshan bsod nams rin chen/ bka' gdams pa las rab tu byung*/ bla ma bya yul ba chen po/ lcags ri gong kha ba/ snyugs rum pa sogs mang du bsten/ zhag bcu lhag 'khyongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes/

phyis mi la dang mjal/ rim gnyis kyi dbang thob/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes mtha' yas/ dgon pa sgam po btab// bu chen rje phag mo grub/ rgyal tshab dwags po sgom tshul/ grub thob dbu se/ rje 'ba' rong ba/ grub thob rnal 'byor chos g.yung sogs mang du 'byung ngo*// zhal nas/ nang ba mi ngan 'dra bas rtag mi thub// sgyu lus g.yar po 'dra ba myur du 'jig /nor rdzas sgyu ma'i bslu brid sdug bsngal rgyu// pha yul bdud kyi brtson ra 'ching byed mkhan// su dag 'di la zhen pa 'khor bar 'khor// 'khor ba'i khong snying bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod/ gsungs/ rin po che po to ba'i po to pa/ spyan snga (440)ba phub chung ba gsum po la sku mched gsum/ khams lung pa dang bzhi po la bka' gdams zhal bzhi/ dge bshes ston pa'i slob ma po tob yon tan mtha' yas/ pu ti byung bshad mdzad/ 'phags pa'i gnas brten gyi sprul par grags/ dgung lo don dgu bzhugs/ grwa pa nyis stong phal cher tshe blos btang*/ bu chen nyi zla lta bu gnyis/ smin drug lta bu drug /dang po gnyis glang thang pa dang shar ba gnyis/ drug ni sprul sku ram sdid ma ba/ snang dre'u lhas pa gnyis/ gnyal na gnyal pa chos 'bar dang*/ bun pa lha rje gnyis/ lon ban+dhe tsan chung ba dang*/ rog dmar zhur pa gnyis/ gsungs bgros sdebs pa la mkhas pa dpe chos mdzad pa so grab pa dang brag dkar ba gnyis te bcu'o// rog dmar zhur ba dang*/ byang sems yang gad pa gcig pa 'dra/ mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho be bum sngon po sdebs/ 'di dang dpe chos gnyis dar che bar byung*/ zhal nas/ shi sbar rtod phur chu rngugs khyer// g.yag rmed i ka ko rlon gtums// gzhu 'bang rgyang mda' khas brgya smra/ zhes pa mi 'chi kha ma'i sbar bar khab skud lta bu tshud na shi nas 'bral thabs med/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i bde skyid la shi sbar 'thams pa de 'bral thabs mi rnyed/ chos yod pa med/ be'u rtod phur la btags pa de rang gis ma mthong ba dang rgyugs pas/

dang po thag 'doms gang la bred gis 'gro/ de nas thag pas 'then pa dang skor skor byas pas/ thag pa ring po rtod phur la dkris nas og ko phur pa la bkal sdod pa min pa 'khyogs thabs med pa'o// de bzhin du dang po chos shig byed snyam rgyugs kyang tshe 'di'i zas gos sogs la zhen pa'i rtod phur ma phyin pas slar 'khyogs thabs med pa re yod par snang*/ dge bshes gsal shes zer ba zhig sde 'khrugs byas nas shi bas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i gsal shes lo gsum gyi gong du shi na sde snod gsum pa zhig shi ba yin pa la/ lo gsum gyis shi ba phyis gsungs/ kho'i (441)rtod phur dgon pa des byas/ rtod phur che chung 'bring gsum po 'di spong nus na chos mi yong ba'i don rang med/ rtsi dbu so rnyis zin pa la mdzo rgod kyis 'ur byas pas chog /ba thag gi thag pa la re'u rgyags thogs don med gsungs/ rta phyugs sogs chu la sgrol ba la dang po nas tsham tshom med pa lam btang na/ chu rgyugs khyer nas 'gror mi nyan phar phul yang tshur phul yong*/ rtsid pu chu mi 'dod pa la kha chur bcug kyang 'gos pa tshun chad sbug tu 'ong*/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i zhen pa btsan thabs su bcad nas chos shig ma byas na/ de nas zhen pa mi spong bar phar bskul yang tshur smra ru 'ong*/ sngar bslabs pa tshun chad kyang med par byed gsungs/ g.yag rmed de dman rma 'tshos/ khal mi brtan/ de bzhin du tshe 'di la glod ma thon pas rang gzhan yo sdug la sbyor tshe 'di la lhod shes pa zhig byung na yongs te nyan du mi gtubs gsungs/ i dka' zhes pa dbyangs la sogs pa 'then pa la dang por i zer ba de 'thon par dka'/ 'go de rgyang rgyang 'then thub byung na de nas sla/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la dang por tshe 'di blos thongs par dka' ba yin/ 'di lan gcig thongs na de nas las sla/ sdug pa rang de yang 'dod yon 'di rang yin/

de min na tshur thod dang rang re khams pa nang rdzu'i kha na med kyi gsungs/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi tshe blos thongs na chos mi yongs ba'i 'di don med 'di dka' ba yin/ 'di la gcig sgril dang zhes nan tan gyis gsungs par gda' yang*/ rang re ni 'di chos kha dmas nas/ mthon po rang zhig 'tshol mthar gang yang min pa re 'ong bar gda'/ yang mi ko rlon gyis gtum pa de dang po lhod lhod 'dra yang bskams nas 'khyogs thabs med par bsdoms nas na tsha bskyed/ gri rnon gcig gis de hrol na skyid lhan gyis 'gro/ de bzhin du tshoms las/ nor bu rna cha bu dang (442)bu mo la// yongs su chags sems gang yin la bltas na// lcags shing dres ma la byas 'ching ma gang*// de dag dam po min zhes 'phags pas gsungs// 'dod pa'i 'ching ma gang yin de lhod kyang*// rab tu grol ba dka' zhes 'phags pas gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i 'dod yon la chags pa zhig yod phyin chad/ dang po lhod lhod 'dra yang gal la thug na ye rang mi spongs par rang gi sdom pa tshun chad blos btang nus pa re yong bar snang*/ des na tshe 'di'i zhen chags 'di hrol ba la shes rab kyi gri rnon po dad pa'i lhag tshan yod pa zhig rang gis byed dgos/ spyir 'dod yon lnga/ de'i nang nas lto gos gnyis/ de yang gos bzhi cha lnga cha yin/ lto ba'i zhen pa 'di rang hro la ba dka' gsungs/ dmag 'thab pa'i dus gzhu 'bod byed du rmog gis ma bde ba la/ rkang chas phud pas mi ngan/ rmog cig dang ci phud byed dgos/ 'ben drud du bzhag nas mda' rgyang du 'phen// rkun ma nags la song ba'i rjes sdod la gcod/ 'dre shar dang glud nub/ chos ma byung tshad tshe 'di ma spangs pas lan 'dug pa lam thon po zhig gis lan pa skad gsungs/ shin tu med par snang*/ da lta mtshan nyid pa'am/ sgom chen nam bka' gdams pa'i phal che ba zhig rlung dbu mar thim pa'i gegs gang gis byas dang*/

de 'dra ba'i mtho mtho mo zhig rang rtsad gcod de/ 'di 'dra mar gnad la gtugs kyin rtsad gcod pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon par gda'/ sa mthon po'i spangs rtogs zhag gnyis nged rang gi nyams su mi lon pa de rnams las nged rang la da lta mi dgos ka med rnams rtsad bcad nas dga' ba la snyam pa yong bar gda'/ 'di 'dra rnams dper na da lta rang mu ges 'chi la khad ba zhig sbyin stong phyug po'i khyim du phyin nas/ da lta mi dgos ka med kyi gza' btung mi 'khyer bar nam phugs phan du re ba'i gser dngul (443)'dra khyer yong ba dang 'dra bar snyam/ khas brgya smra zhes pa/ khams pa rnams gtam gleng dus khas brgya smra/ rngam stong g.yugs kyang don 'di yin/ zhes gtam gyi mdor smra/ de bzhin du thos bsam sgom gsum ci byas kyang*/ chos ma byung ba de tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod 'dis lan gsungs/ skyes bu rnams khong gi gsung 'di kun la go rgyu zhig rang gda'// da lta rang re snyigs dus kyi chos byed 'dod rnams/ bka' rgya che/ lung grangs mang*/ ji skad gsungs kyang hril gyis dril na nga la da lta bsgrub bya dang*/ spang bya gzhan gang yang med tshe blos thongs pa zhig rang 'dod snyam pa byas kyin 'bung dgos gsungs pa der gda'/ de 'dra zhig rang dgos/ gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med do skyes bu kun/ god mo them rtsa wa dang sbre/ gong mo zhes pa rang gi chu tshur khar sre mos gong mo'i ske la bzung*/ der gong mos pha khar 'phur bas/ sre mo shed/ gong mo 'bri skam 'dra ba zhig bsad lags te/ pha yul mes btsan zhig dang gtan bral byas zer lo// de bzhin du tshe 'di'i mi gnye 'dis 'dod yon re dang myong ste/ mtho ris thar pa rnams dang gtan bral byas gsungs/ them rtsa zhes pa 'di nas rgya gar du 'gro ba la dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol gyi g.yang rtsad gcod pa min pa them rtsa'i g.yang la zon ma byung bas der lhung nas shi ba bzhin du sa lam mthon po'i spangs rtogs rtsad gcod pa min pa/

tshe 'dir zhen pa'i g.yang la zon ma byung bas der lhung nas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong*/ des na skyu srab pa yang dga' ste/ sgyu rtsal gzab gsungs wa dang spre zhes pa wa gzha' mkhas te rde'u tsam re'i rgyab tu'ang gzha' thub/ spe 'khri mkhas to 'jag ma tsam la'ang 'khri shes/ g.yi gab mkhas pas/ gad pa rta rnga tsam re'i nang du'ang gab shes/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i mi gnye 'di gzha' (444)mkhas/ 'khri mkhas/ gab mkhas te/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'am/ thos bsam sgom gsum mam/ bya btang kun spangs yin zer ba re la'ang tshe 'di'i mig nye re 'ong gsungs/ zla ba phyugs lhag lhan cig min/ zla ba zhes pa zhogs lung par mi zhig gi bu shi bas gza' zla bas gnod byas pas/ der kho zla ba la mi sha len zer/ khos tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo zla ba 'char pa'i ri 'go yid la bzhag nas/ bco lnga'i nub mo mda' gzhu khyer phyin pas/ ri 'gor slebs pa dang zla ba pha tshad du song 'dug pas/ khos gyang ra ba 'dis bya btang nas zer lo// de bzhin du 'o cis kyang chos shig bya snyam thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas kyang chos dang 'phrad rgyu med par je ring du song gsungs/ des na tshe 'di la rtag par 'dzin pa ni yon tan brgya yod kyang skyon gcig gi 'og tu chud pa yin pas/ phyi mar phan pa gang yang med/ des na tshe 'dir zhen nas phyi ma phan chad kyi rtog pa med par sangs rgyas kyis tshun chad gtan la phab kyang phan pa med/ dud 'gro dang khyad par med ces shar bas gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ ltogs kyi dogs pa las shi ba'i dogs pa ni ye mi 'dug na gsungs/ phyugs lha ces pa ni/ tshe 'di shes pa la khyo ga grung por rtsi na/ phyugs dang dud 'gro nged rang las lhag pa yod de/ dmigs bus tshang la gnam phug byas sprul gyis ded pa dang*/ kho rang gi gnam phug bzos pa de la byin/ sprul gyi rked par so btab nas bsad lo// gzhan yang spras kyi brag rgyab tu bya rog gis 'ug pa

'ug pas bya rog gis phru gu bsad nas zos/ bya rog gis kyang 'ug pa'i phru gu/ khos gong du bsad ba dang zos pa der khyer nas bsad zos kyi lan byas/ la sha glan pa dang*/ rgyal du g.yag yu bo g.yag rwa can gyis yu bo brdungs/ khos 'khon bzung*/ 'thab lugs sbyangs (445)te slar 'thab pas yu bos rwa can bsad pa byung gsungs/ ngang rwa can 'thabs pa dang*/ ke kas ke ka la bya rog gis gnod pa byas/ ke ka bstod lung gi ke ka tshun bsdus/ 'phan yul gyi bya rog la sha glan pa byung gsungs/ bya rog la dmag drangs pa sogs gsungs/ gnyen dang bu skyong ba sogs ni de bas kyang dud 'gro mkhas te zla ba re la'ang pha mnyam bu mnyam tshar/ sog rum dang*/ bzo mkhas pa ni byi ba dang khug rta dang bung ba sogs la ltos/ des na tshe 'di'i don tsam las sgrub mi nus na skyes bu'am mi zhes pa'i ming don rang yang mtshar gsungs/ lhan cig min zhes pa/ tshe 'di ma nyams pa gcig dang phyi ma'i chos gnyis lhan cig tu mi yong*/ pags pa gcig la spus brang lag pas theg tshad gcig dang*/ rlid bu chu thub pa gnyis 'ong pa med gsungs/ sa paṇa gyi zhal nas kyang*/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor par// gtan gyi phan bde thar pa re ba de// rmongs pa'i zhen 'dod gzu lums nyid yin pas// tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs// zhes gsungs/ chos rje bus/ sngon bsags bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i lus// dal 'byor rten 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che las sgrol ba'i gru// don med chud zos ma rtogs dpyod med pa yi/ byed rin chen grub/ gsungs/ chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang*/ dam pa'i chos dang tshe 'di'i 'dun ma gnyis// mnyam du 'grub pa su yang yod ma yin// bsgrub par 'dod pa de dag rang nyid kyis// rang nyid bslu ba nyid la the tshom med// phrad kyang lab rgyu de las ma mchis pas// so so'i gnas su lus ngag dge la sbyor// zhes mtshams mdzad pa'i sgo la glan pa yin par gda'/

dkon mchog brtsegs par yang*// chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin (446)te// bdun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas// gang gis smon lam ci btab pa// de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug tu yang*/ dge ba'i phyogs ni thams cad kyi// rtsa ba mos par thub pas gsungs// zhes rang gang la snying phur thebs 'dun pa byas pa dang*/ mos pa byas pa dang*// sems bskyed pa ci 'dra ba'i 'bras bu thob par gsungs pa min pa/ gang dman pa 'ga' bsgrubs pa'i zhor la/ de bas ches mchog tu gyur pa 'grub yongs mi gsung bar gda'// skyes bu gsum dang theg pa gsum la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'dun pa dang*/ sems bskyed kho na'i khyad du snang ba des na nged rang tshe 'di'i 'dod pa la snying phur thebs nas de la 'dun pa byed/ mos pa byed/ de'i phyir du sems bskyed nas de la/ gang phan dang ci phan byed pa la/ de bas mchog tshe phyi ma'i don tsam yang yod pa mi snang na byang chub thob pa lta yang ci smos/ des na phyi mar dmyal bar skye ba tshun chod kyang sngar gyi las dang 'chi khar drod chil li bsnying la 'dod pa lta bu'i 'dod 'dun drag pos dmyal ba'i me nang lta bur rtsang gis sleb yod/ thams cad 'dod 'dun drag pos las mang du bsags pa'i 'dod pa de 'grub yong ba yin par snang*/ des na tshe 'di'i 'dod pa'i 'di mi spong ba'i thabs rang med do// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ rje rin po che la yang*/

rje tsong kha pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don sgrubs pa la mthu nus bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ bka' mdo rgyud shes bya thams cad thugs su chud cing*/ sems can rnams la mas bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba/ phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par lhun gyis grubs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan brnyes kyang tha mal pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don la 'khor ba ji srid bar bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ de'i rnam thar phrin las mtha' yas ni thams cad la mngon sum du gsal zhing*/ de re gsungs (447) rab khyad par can 'di lta bu'i phrin las kyis bstan pa dang sems can la phan btags pa bzhin na sngon gyi dus su yang dkon par byung ngo zhes mkhas pa rnams sleng ngo*/ rje de nyid kyis/ dge ldan dang*/ gsang sngags mkhar btab/ rdzing phyi'i zhig gsos gnang*/ btsun mo tshal/ 'bras spungs/ ser ra sogs 'debs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/ dgung lo re gsum bzhugs/ rje nyid kyi dngos spong chos kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa bcu gnyis ni/ dge ldan du rje dar ma rin chen/ rje mkhas grub pa/ rje zhwa lu pa/ rje blo gros pa/ rje bso ba/ btsun mo tshal du rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ 'bras spungs su rje 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ ser ra bla ma dar rgyas bzang po/ rje gung ru pa/ gsang sngags mkhar du bla ma cog chen pa/ rdzing phyir bzang skyong ba/ nyi ma gling du bla ma byang sems pa dang bcu gnyis so// gzhan yang*/ rje byams chen chos rje/ rje btsun/ rje btsun shes rab seng ge/ rje dge 'dun grub pa sogs phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa mtha' yas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa bdun/ thugs sras rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems dpa' bde thang ba sogs byung*/ sems dpa' kun bzang pas mdo sngags gling btab/ byang sems rwa sgreng pas sgo mo mtsho kha btab/ byang sems sbre zhing pa chen pos dol gyi dgon gsar btab/

byang sems bde thang pas zhal lta mdzad pa sogs kyi dgon pa che chung bcu gsum thebs/ rje mkhas grub pas ri bo mdangs can btab/ mal dro'i byang sems 'dul ba dge 'dun rin chen gyis mal dro stod du rin chen gling btab/ bla ma grags rin pa yon mchod kyis cha dkar btab/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis bkris lhun chos sde btab/ bshes gnyen dam pa de dag ni rje'i dngos slob thugs sras sku yon mtha' yas pa sha stag ste/ rje de nyid kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i bu chen rnams kyis btab pa'i phrin las kyi chos sde ni dbus gtsang mdo khams rgya sog mnga' ri bcas la mtha' yas par snang ngo*// sems dpa' bde thang pas// rje'i dngos slob chen po rdog chos rdor gyi brgyud pa spre zhing sems dpa' chen po dgung lo dgu bcu bzhes pa de la 'bul ba dngul zho stong tsam (448)bskyal/ rje'i dngos slob bla ma byang gling pa chen po/ bod kyi bla ma che ba zhig la khong gi sku tshe ring shos thug par snang*/ rje la de dus kyis bshes gnyen thams cad kyis btags pas/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po dang*/ chos rje rong pos kyang chos gsan khong rnam gnyis kyis kyang*/ ngor dgon gsar dang*/ na len+d+ra gnyis btab bo// dang por 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas shig med na/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu las mi 'da' bas/ bskyed rdzogs sogs zab pa yang re zhig bzhag nas nges 'byung ma skyes bar du 'bad dgos gsungs pa lags par gda'/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i byams pa'i dpal gyis khro phu'i byams chen bzhengs/ khong gi bla ma paṇa chen shākya shrī rab gnas mdzad/ de'i sras khro phub bsod nams seṅge/ de'i slob ma bu ston rin chen grub/ rje phag gru'i slob ma kun ldan gtsang gnas khro phu pa rnams byon/ zhal nas kyang*/ tshe srog lbu bar ma shes shing*// zhe nas 'chi ba ma dran na// dge phyogs mang po byas gyur kyang*// da dung tshe 'di'i lag cha yin// rnyed grags sgyu mar ma shes shing*// tshe 'dod khe drags ma bor na// mi yis dam par bzung gyur kyang*// da dung chos brgyad khol po yin// tshe 'di thed la ma bor na// ji tsam dge la 'bad byas kyang*// phyi mar lag stong gcer bur 'gro// phyi ma ci khyer a tsa ma// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma go zhing*// 'dod yon tshim pa la mchis na// kha lta'i rbad khams che na yang*// da dung zog po rdzun can yin/

gsungs/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang*/ kho bo'i sgom pa rin chen bla ma sgom skad/ bsgom rtsa na bsgoms pas dar yug dang ja sig sogs mang po yong sems na ji tsam bsgoms pa sdig pa yin/ sgom tsa na/ skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar dbyung*/ byang chub mchog gi sa bon gdab sems na sems dpa' tsam zhig byas (449)pa'i bsod nams kyang nam mkhar mi shong gsungs/ chos rje bus/ tshe 'di'i mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// chags sdang longs spyod gsog cing 'khor bsdus kyang*// 'khor dang longs spyod rjes su mi 'brang bar/ las 'bras sdug bsngal rang nyid gcig pus myong*// tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras thob kyang mi brtan zhing*// shi nas ngan 'gror mi 'gro'i nges med kyi// 'khor bar yid 'byung byos shig rin chen grub/ ces khong rang la gdams par mdzad pa 'di thams cad kyis go 'tshal/ rgyal ba yang yang dgon pa ni/ sa paṇa ko brag pa rgod tshang pa sogs bsten/ yon tan mtha' yas sprul skur yang bshad do// dgon pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ spyir chos mthon po kho na la dga'/ dma' mo tshos blo mi khengs// stong stong ngo*// med med po// mtho mtho po zhig kho na la dga' ste/ chos kyis pho sgo gang zag gis rtogs tshod du mi 'dug /chos rdzogs pa chen po yin pas mi phan gang zag rdzogs pa chen por 'gro dgos/ chos skad la rta rib mang po byas nas gang zag la khyi mi ri ba mang po mthong*/ chos tshig rkyang du song nas lag len la mi 'debs pa de pag shi'i glu skad ne tsos 'don pa dang khyad med/ chos gcig go gnyis go lag len la 'debs/ gcig shes gnyis shes rang rgyud la sbyor ba zhig dgos/ chos rang gi rgyud thog tu ma byon/ sems dang chos kyi phye chu ma 'dres par chos dang gang zag gi bar na har pa mi shong ba tsam byas/ chos glo ba'i tshod ma bzhin kha la tsa le byas pa des chos kyi don byed mi nus pa lags mod/

cha 'bal le/ ke ke re byas nas mi nyan pa mang po gda' ste/ de tsa na chos kyi dgos pa ma 'grub pa lags mod/ ngas ni tshe blos gtong ba la bsgrub pa'i (450)'khril du byas pa yin ne sdes bu kun gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ bla ma spang blo gros brtan pa/ dgra bcom pa bsod nams grags pa/ bu ston sogs bla ma mang*/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byangs/ gdul bya phrin las che// yi dam zhal gzigs/ dgung lo bdun cu don grangs bar du dngul chu chos rdzong du bstan pa skyongs/ rgya 'jam dpal gsum sogs bu chen mang ngo*// che'i zhal nas kyang*// dam chos thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba la// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs sgrub pa la rtse gcig pa'i// glod na 'di las bar chad che ba med// de'i phyir rnam pa kun tu 'di spang bya// thos bsam sgom gsum dge ba gang byed kyang*/ blo ngan 'di dang 'dres na ro brgya'i zas// ngan skyugs dag dang 'dres pa ji bzhin du// bzang po ngan par byed pa gdon mi za// dpon slob mched grogs gnyen rnams rtsod byed cing*// sdig sdug gtam ngan kun la mi 'dzem par// ngal ba chen pos longs spyod sgrub byed pa// blo ngan 'di yis dbang med bskul bar zad// gzhan gyi dpal 'byor gzhom phyir lus sems kyi// 'bad ba drag pos 'thab dang rtsod byas nas// rang gzhan 'di phyi gnyis kar 'phung byed pa// de yi snying du blo ngan gdon 'di zhugs// gsung rab sgron me lag tu thogs nas kyang*// rnyed bkur 'khor sde'i don du 'thab rtsod sogs// sdig pa'i g.yang sar goms pa 'dor ba'i mig /blo ngan rab rib 'di yis bsgribs par zad// nor mang sbyin yang grags dang 'khor la sogs// don du gnyer phyir sbyin pa chen po las// 'bras bu chung zhing ngan par bsgyur byed pa// glo ngan ba mo 'di yis bcom par nges// 'bad pas tshul khrims bsrungs kyang rnyed sogs kyi// 'ching bas bcings nas thar lam mi (451)bgrod cing*// 'khor ba'i btson rar 'thid byed lcags sgrog de// blo ngan 'di yi lag na nges par gnas// yun ring bsam gtan bsgoms kyang chags sdang gis// bdag bstod gzhan smod byed cing 'thab rtsod byed zhi gnas bsgoms pas ma zhi'i blo skyes pa// blo ngan yur ma'i rtsa ba yod pas len// nad gdon chom rkun dgra sogs dam chos kyi// bar chad yin zhes grags kyang rang gi blo// las su rung na de kun grogs su 'gyur// blo ngan 'di ni dam chos gegs su nges// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs bsgrub pas 'grub pa dka'// grub kyang rang dbang spyad pa'i nges pa med// bdag la nges par 'ong ba 'chi ba yin// de tshe nor dang 'khor sogs kyis mi phan// de dang bral bas lhag par sdug bsngal 'gyur// de ltar bsams nas tshe 'di'i che thabs spangs/

zhes gsungs/ tshe blos btang gi chos 'di ni zab pa bas kyang ches zab pa zhig yin te/ zab pa zhes bya ba ni blos gting dpag dka' zhing*/ rtogs dka' ba dang*/ sdug bsngal sel ba dang*/ bde ba sgrubs pa'i thabs gnad can/ gzhan na med pa zhig yod pa la zab pa zhes zer la/ tshe blos gtong gi chos 'di ni gting dpag dka' zhing rtogs dka' ste// rgya gar rang du yin na dngos smra ba sems tsam pa man chad su'i mdun du yin yang*/ chos thams cad bden par med/ stong pa nyid yin byas na/ a pa 'di 'dra'i kha 'chal zer ba smyo ba yin nam snyam pa yong ba yin par snang*/ de bzhin du tshe 'di la zhen pa'i dge bshes bka' bcu 'dzin pa'am/ bla ma skye bo brgya stong gis phyag byed pa'am/ rgyud sde bzhin kha ton byed/ dkyil 'khor brgya'i zhal phye ba'am/ mtshams dang 'dags sbyar gyis dus 'da' zhing lha dang rtsa rlung bsgom pa'am/ phyag (452)chen dang zhi byed rdzogs chen nyams su len pa kha po 'brug ltar grags pas kyang*/ chos 'di mig gis mi rtogs bar tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dang bde skyid thams cad po 'di blos btang dgos byas na/ a pa 'di 'dra ba'i kha 'chal zer ba snyam nas blor mi shong*/ chos 'di la dngangs pa dang skrag pa dang*/ sba bkong ba skye/ gzhan tshe 'di'i phun tshogs blos btang ba mthong na'ang de lkugs pa dang sam gnyen bshes la sogs pa su'i khe la yang ma nyan par sprang 'khyams la 'gro ba zer nas glen pa dang go mchod du rtsi/ bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byed thams cad tshe 'dir sdug po sogs mi yong ba dang*/ mi gral du chud nas skyid po byed pa rnams su chud pa dang*/ mis mthong cha 'jog yod pa/ dngos po phyug pa mi la re mi dgos pa/ lag bag deng mi dgos sbrang mi dgos par ja dkar nag sha mar mthud gsum chil le longs spyad rgyu yod pa/ khyed chos pa'am mkhas pa la sogs pa yin zer nas mis bstod pa skyid pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas/

rang yang de ltar 'bad/ gzhan la'ang de ltar slob/ de ltar shes na pho rgod pa dang shes che bar byed pa snang na/ gzhan khyim pa la sogs pa'i blor chog zab mo 'di mi shod pa lta yang ci smos/ da lta rtsa rlung ngam stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i chos la thams cad dga' tshor byed/ grogs gnyis gsum du tshogs na'ang de'i gleng mo kho na gleng*/ de'i nyams len la 'bad 'bungs 'dod pa ni shin tu mang bar yang snang*/ tshe blos gtang gi chos la dga' tshor byed mkhan rang dkon/ tshe 'di'i gnyen dang nye 'brel zhing khang dang nor rdzas sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs 'di blos thong zhig bya ba'i chos bshad na/ bong bu'i mgo la dbyugs brgyab pa ltar nag tham gyis 'gro/ sna rus pa na ting nge nyan ye ma 'dod/ nyams su len (453)ye mi 'dod pa yong ba der snang*/ 'di shab shob ni min/ nyams su len 'dod pa yod na tshur shog dang*/ rang re khams pa nang brdzu'i khan med pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon 'gro mgon rin po che ni/ dgyer chen po'i dbon po// spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa nyid du gsungs/ rdzu 'phrul mngon shes mtha' yas/ bu chen bcu bzhi la/ dbon po chen po gnyis ni blon po ston pa/ bla ma sangs yon/ dwags po na bang rim dang*/ bzang mo ba gnyis/ lho brag shar du dbu ma pa/ nub tu dge shong ba/ e'i sengs sgang ba/ gnyal nas 'byung ba/ dol du mche ba can pa/ grab du zong dgon pa/ zhog thong ston pa/ mchang ngam pa/ byin nas slob dpon lam pa/ gtsang na gtsang ston nyi ma/ nyang stod la dgon pa gnyis/ de dag ni du mas dgon pa gsar pa btab/ kha cig gis rnying pa'i gdan sa bskyangs/ de rnams las kyang chos brgyud dang dgon pa mang du 'phel lo// po'i zhal nas kyang*// tshe 'di'i mkhas btsun bsgom chen yang*// tshe 'di'i mkhas lo btsun lo 'dod// mtshams bcad ya them yi ge bris// mi dang mi 'phrad sgom chen yang*// tshe 'di'i sgom chen bzang lo 'dod/

sbyin gtong byas kyang tshe 'di yi// byas lo gtong lo kho na 'dod// dper na chu la phye btab 'dra// tha na dkon mchog mchod pa re// byas kyang mi yis mthong du re// rnam rtog mi dran dgu dran 'dis// ci byed rnams la 'dis slebs pas// dge sbyor ci byas lo lor 'chor// thams cad lo pa'i rta pas khyer// des na tshe 'di'i rnam rtog la// mdud re 'debs dgos skyes bu kun// 'di la mdung re ma thebs na// mkhas btsun ston sgom thams cad kyis// ngan song gsum gyi sgo mi khegs// ngan song sdug bsngal ma bzlog pa'i// mkhas pa btsun po sgom chen gyis// dgos pa ci yod (454)mdo don shor// mi tshe hril gyis grwa sar bsdad// rgas khar tshe 'di ma spongs pas// gnas gzhi dgon pa'i zhen pa byas// sde 'khrugs la sogs sdig pa rnams// byas nas gnas dgon shul du bzhag /rang nyid mnar med me nang du// 'gro ba thams cad mi rtag pa// ma bsams pa yis len pa yin// mdor na 'chi ba mi rtag pa// bdag gi rgyud la ma skyes na// gsang ba 'dus pa mi zab ste// 'chi ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe// skyabs 'gro tshig gsum zab pa yin// mthon po'i chos la snyegs snyegs nas// g.yang du lhung ngo skyes bu gud// de tshe thab mo'i gdams ngag kyang*// phyi nang log pa nyid du 'gyur/ gsungs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ tshe blos gtong ba la gtad pa bzhi// rdo rje gsum/ bud snyegs thob gsum dgos pa yin gsungs/ dang po bzhi ni/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phyags shi la gtad/ shi 'ugs grog po stong bar gtad/ rdo rje gsum ni/ thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang*/ khrel med rdo rje sa la 'jog /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ phyi ma gsum/ mi khyu nas bud/ khyi gral snyegs/ lha gral thob gsum mo// 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis rab byung ji ltar mdzad/

dka' ba lo drug tu spyad lugs/ rjes 'jug la ji ltar rab tu byung ba sogs gsungs lugs rnams go na gong gi gnad rnams shin tu zab pa/ chos kyi mthil du go nas 'ong*/ de bcu la phugs nor bcu zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad// de rnams yid la bzhag pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi 'khrul pa 'joms/ chags zhen gyi rgya mtsho skams/ chos brgyad kyi ri bo bsnyil/ nyon mongs kyi rdzong bskyil/ (455)las ngan gyi gru 'jig /gnyen po'i thang bde ba la slobs pas/ phugs nor gyi mchog rab tu snang te/ 'og ma rnams su yang rgyas bar 'chad par 'gyur ba las rtogs par bya'o// de bas na tshe blos gtong gi chos 'di blos gting dpag par dka'/ thams cad kyis rtogs par dka' zhing gsang ba'i gnas yin pas na/ zab mo gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos bya ba 'di lags/ gzhan yang phan bde thob pa'i thabs gzhan la med pa 'di la yod pas na/ yang chos 'di zab mo gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa lags te/ tshe 'di'i bde ba dang*/ phyi ma'i bde ba dang*/ byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi bar thams cad 'dis tshegs med par 'grub pas so// 'o na tshe blos gtong ba de tshe 'di'i bde ba rnams spong ba min nam/ tshe blos btang bas tshe 'di'i bde ba ji ltar 'grub snyam na/ de khyed bden te/ a re 'dod kyis myong ba yin// chen po 'dod pas skal ba chad// mthon po 'dod pas g.yang du lhung skad na/ bde bde mo// skyid skyid po zhig bya dgos snyam pa la skyid po yong ba mi nam byung yang kho rang shes/ dgos pa med snyam pa zhig la skyid po yong ba yin lo// rnal 'byor pa rtags mi 'dod kyang*/ rtags kyis rnal 'byor pa mi gtong ba zer ram sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ 'dod pa spangs pa'i rtsa na gda'/ mi zer ram/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ nyams myong can gyi sgo khang na/ skyid po sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ zhim lto can gyis ma tshor bar yod pa yin/

gnyen po can gyi sgo khang na/ 'jig rten blos gtong sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ chags sdang can gyis ma tshor bar yod pa yin/ rtsa ba chod pa'i sgo khang na/ blo bde sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ re dogs can gyis (456)ma tshor ba yod pa yin/ chog shes can gyi sgo khang na/ phyug po sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ 'dod pa can gyis ma tshor ba yod pa yin/ gsungs/ rtogs ldan bsam gtan dpal gyi zhal nas kyang*/ tshe 'di skyid 'dod sdug bsngal yin/ rlung la bskur na gtan skyid 'byung*/ gsungs// shwa bo

shwa bo ba'i mtshan pad+ma byang chub/ sku mched gsum gyi slob ma/ 'phan yul rgyal sha bo sgong du gdul bya bskyangs/ lung rtogs rgya che/ gshegs dus kyang sbur ril po ring bsrel du song 'dug zer ro// sgang pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ da la blo gtod nus pa yod na skyid du bzhug tu yod pa yin te snyam/ 'o na nga yang blo gtong snyam na thabs gzhan med/ man ngag gzhan med tshe 'di blos gtong 'jug pa yin gsungs/ yang shwa bo sgang pa'i zhal nas/ 'o skol gyi tshe 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad tshe 'di'i 'dod pa yin pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa bsgrub bya skyungs dgos/ tshe 'di'i bsgrub bya ches tsa na thugs mi bde/ gar rgyug cha med/ de tsam na sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum dus gcig la 'ong*/ des na 'dod pa'i blo sna mang po 'di bzlog dgos/ 'dod pa'i blo sna bzlog tu btub tsa na skyid 'go tshugs pa yin/ des na tshe 'di phyi thams cad bde ba sgrub pa la/ yas rtags su snying la ci yang mi 'dod la ci yang mi gsog pa zhig dgos/ rnyed pa mi 'dod tsa na rnyed pa'i mchog yin/ snyan pa mi 'dod tsa na snyan pa'i mchog yin/ grags pa mi 'dod rtsa na grags pa'i mchog yin/ 'khor mi 'dod tsa na 'khor gyi mchog yin/ snying nas chos byed na blo sbrang la gtod dgos/ sprang gi tha mar 'chir 'jug nus dgos/ blo sna de lta bu zhig skyes pa na lha 'dre mi gsum gyis 'o (457)brgyal du mi 'jug nges pa yin/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa la bskam sha btsal nas rang sma rang gis phab/ rang sdug rang gis byas/ mis 'phya la rang sdug pa phyi ma la ngan song du 'gro ba rnams yong ba yin gsungs/ skyes mchog pas kyang mtshan bsam gtan pa la/ 'phan yul rgya brag chos rje'i slob ma/ lung rtogs rgya che/ sgo mo yab kyi dgon pa btab/ gzhan don rgya che bar byung*/ g.yag sde paṇa chen la sogs bu chen kyang mang*/ skyes mchog chos rjer yang grags//

tshe 'di rlung la bskur nus na// zhen log po zhes 'dogs pa lags// cis kyang dgos pa med rtsa na// grags pas sa steng khyab pa lags// lus srog chos phyir thongs tsa na// snyan pa'i bser bus bskyod pa lags// gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas kyang*/ g.yan pa 'phrugs na bde 'gyur la// de bas g.yan pa med na bde// de bzhin 'jig rten 'dod ldan bde// 'dod pa med pa de bas bde// chos ni lugs kyi dam pa ste// chos kyis 'jig rten mngon dgar 'gyur// 'jig rten dga' bar gyur pas kyang*// 'di dang gzhan du bslu mi 'gyur// chos la rgyal srid byed pa dang*// phyogs rnams kun tu grags pa yis// bla re rgya chen 'byung 'gyur zhing*// slob dpon rnams kyang kun tu 'dud// khyod kyi rgyal srid chos bzhin du// grags don 'dod slad ma lags na// des na shin tu 'bras bu bcas// de las gzhan 'gyur don ma mchis// zhes rgyal po la gdams pa lags te khyod kyis chos bzhin byas tshe 'di'i 'dod pa spangs na tshe 'dir yang rnyed bkur snyan grags sogs ci 'dod pa thams cad yod/ rgyal srid gzung bas kyang rang gzhan (458)yongs la phan thogs/ de las gzhan du khyod 'dod pa la snying phur thebs na khyod kyis rgyal srid bzung ba'ang don ma mchis gsung ba lags par gda'/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ gang gi 'jig rten 'di thong dka'// de ni gzhan las blun pa nyid// gang dag de rjes 'gro de dag /shin tu yun ring bslu bar 'gyur/ zhes chos legs par byas pas tshe 'dir rang yang gzhan las skyid par 'ong ba la/ de tsam yang mi rtogs pa ni/ blun pa'am glen pa yin pas/ des rang gzhan phung*// des na chos legs par byas pas bde ba'i gnas su sleb par gal che bar gsungs// slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ g.yeng ba med pa'i tshul can chos mchog gang thob pas// sngon chad ma thob pa yi skyid pa'ang rab 'thob cing*// bde ba las ni nam yang nyams par 'gyur ba med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bde mchog mi zad dang*// sangs rgyas go 'phang mnyam med phun sum tshogs pa'ang thob/

ces bslab btus kyi thog mar gsungs so// bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas kyang*/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms su/ gal te bde ba kun 'dod na// 'dod pa thams cad yongs su spongs// 'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na// mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur// ji srid 'dod pa'i rjes 'brang ba// de yi bar du ngoms mi 'gyur// de la gang dag shes rab kyi// ldog byed de dag tshim pa thob// 'dod pas ngoms par mi 'gyur bar// shes rab kyis ni ngoms pa bskyed// shes rab kyis ni ngoms pa'i mi// srid pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs// 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas kyang*/ shes rab kyi sa 'tsho ba chos kyi longs spyod spyad pa'i bde ba ni/ (459)bzang btung dang bud med dang glu gar 'dod pa la longs spyod pa'i bde bas ye mi do ba zhig yin gsungs/ ji ltar yin byas byas/ bza' btung sogs la spyad pa'i bde ba ni lus mtha' dag la khyab pa min pa dang*/ phyi rol gyi rkyen la rag las pas nam 'dod du mi 'byung bas res 'ga' ba dang*/ khams gsum car na yod pa min pa dang*/ phyis 'phags pa'i nor thob pa min pa dang*/ longs spyad pas zad pa dang*/ dgra la sogs pas rgyun gcod nus pa dang*/ tshe phyi mar 'khyer du med pa dang*/ bsten pas mthar phyin pa dang chog pa dang ngoms pa med pa dang*/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed pa dang*/ mdze nad phrugs pa'i bde ba bzhin du sdug bsngal zhi ba la bde ba'i ming btags pa tsam yin pa dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa bskyed pa dang*/ srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i nyes par spyod pa bskyed pa yin la/ chos kyi longs spyod las byung ba'i bde ba ni lus thams cad la khyab/ nam 'dod du 'byung*/ khams gsum gar yod/ 'phags pa'i nor thob/ longs spyad pas mi zad pa'i steng du 'phel/ dgra la sogs pas med par byar med/ tshe phyi mar 'khyer du yod/

mthar phyin pas ngoms pa yod/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gang yang mi bskyed/ bde ba ming rtags pa tsam yin/ nyon mongs pa dang nyes spyod thams cad 'joms pas chos khyad par 'phags pa yin/ gsungs/ dge bshes 'ban la yon bdag 'dra mjal yong zer bas/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa ci bzang bshams/ der bsam pa la brtags pas yon bdag gi ngor/ mdzes chos 'dod par snang bas/ slar (460)thal ba spar ba gang gtor nas/ dge slong rang zo ma byed par bzhugs shig gsungs/ de pha dam pas gsan pas/ bde ba dkon mchog mchod pa la/ 'ban gung rgyal gyi thal ba sbar ba gang po de bzang gsungs/ rgyal lha khang du zho ston zhig byung ba/ lag bde bas gral gong yar chob chob drangs pas/ 'ban snyam 'di na mar la mi thebs pa byed pa 'dug snyam du byung ba la/ dran pas zin nas khyod kha na dgongs te phor ba kha sbub bzhag /zho bzed byas pas/ blo nyes pos da ci nas 'thungs zin gsungs nas bzhes ma nyan/ khong gi yo byad than thun yod pa rnams rgyal lha khang du phul nas sprang gin chos mdzad/ skabs shig 'phen yul stod du/ brdungs dang rkun ma mang du byung bas/ mi rnams kyi dngos po sbas skungs dang rub 'chos byas pa'i skad gsan pas/ khong la chu bum gog po zhig dang*/ chos gos shig ma gtogs rdzas med pas/ chos gos de dpung par bkal/ chu bum de phyag tu thogs nas/ nga'i rub 'chos 'di min bya thabs yod dam gsungs/ de la po to ba mnyes nas/ 'ban gyi rub 'chos de yin gsungs nas/ snam bu zhig skur kho la 'chi ba 'ong bas ro dkris dgos/ 'o cag la mi 'ong bas mi dgos gsungs/ chos byed pa la khong gi de 'dra zhig dgos te/ rgyags dang ja dang*/ chu sngor mang po tshags byed pa la chos mi 'ong gsungs/ brag dkar bas kyang*/ grab pa dang po to ba'i dngos slob dpe chos dang por sdeb mkhan/ thag dkar ba bod khar bzhugs/ dgung lo brgyad cu/ grwa pa sum brgya/

gra pa ya 'phan yul gra bab/ gra gnas gsar dang pho brang sdings btab/ mtshan gzhon nu 'od/ dgung lo re lnga bzhugs so// phan bus kyang gung rgyal gyi rub 'chos de la (461)a na re bstan 'tshal ces byas gsungs lo// 'ban gyi zhal nas/ nga mi skya'i dus na mda' gzhu tshor ma 'dra ba btags/ gri gnyis gsum re btsugs kyang dgra mang zun nyungs/ nga pho reng mi gcig la ston thog bzhi bcu thon pas grong pa rnams kyis nga'i ming bzhi bcu sdigs su btags/ nyin mo la kha'i jag pa/ mtshan mo grong gi rkun ma byas kyang lto ma phyid/ nga mtshon cha spangs pas dgra mi gcig med/ las ka mchil ma rdo la mi 'bod te lto phyir/ mu ge ci byung yang su phyug pa gcig dang mjing bsgril nas zar yod/ sngar nga'i khas zas mi rnyed// da lta zas kyis nga'i kha mi rnyed/ zos pas ni mi 'dzad/ 'thung pas ni mi yog /chos bden bsam pa 'di nyis bstud sum bsdud 'chor/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī byon pa na bod ston rnams rta rmig lcags kyis gtums nas lta ba rtsad gcod par mnga' ris phyogs su 'gro ba la/ khong mi tsher thos pa byas yang 'gro na/ da thos pa ma byas pa yang 'gro dgos bsam pa la yang ga re thos pa byas na nyon mongs chung ngu 'gro zer ba la/ nga'i nyon mongs pa ni chung ngu song 'dug /khong thos pa byas pa nyon mongs pa chung ngu ma song ba 'di/ kha brgyud mar song bas lan/ da ni nga rang gi 'dis chog par snang*/ da ni ston pa zhig byas kyang yod dam sems/ sgom chen zhig /gtso bo zhig /gnas brtan zhig byas kyang yod dam sems gsungs/ khong nyon mongs pa dang 'thab pa'i dus su 'dod pa'i blo skyes pa na/ phyag g.yas pas g.yon nas 'then gyin kho de 'ban gung rgyal sku tshe ring ba gshegs pa med par rig 'dzin gyi gnas su bzhugs pa yang zer/ chos pa bzang bskyid pa'i tshad pher/ da dung khong gi snyan grags sgrogs/ po to bo'i slob ma gnyen po bzang ba 'tshad pher/

(462) 'khrungs sa 'phan sa yul lo// gsungs/ nas ngan brgya rigs rjed byed/ rang gis rang tshar gcod/ nyon mongs pa chung nyal ba byung ba na/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba gsungs nas/ phyag g.yas pa nas 'then gyin rang spro ba skyed pa yin skad/ ci la 'tshal na khong jag rkun cig gis tshe blos gtang ba la de ltar 'bad pas bde skyid de 'dra ba 'byung gda' na/ po to ba'i zhal nas kyang*/ chos shig byas na tshe 'di rang la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod ste/ da mi skya'i dus gser khar lan gsum phyin pa la/ gser zho gcig kyang ma rnyed/ da lta ni nyin re la'ang gser srang mang po yod yud ba lung pa na kham lung pa las bde skyid snyan gsum che ba med/ klungs shod na spyan snga ba las skyid pa med/ dam chos bzhin byas pa las byung ba yin gsungs/ spyan snga bas spyan snga ba'i mtshan tshul khrims 'bar/ jo bo rje las chos 'brel thob/ gtso bor ston pas bskyangs/ rwa sgreng du khams pa ye shes 'bar dang khong gnyis la ting nge 'dzin bzang ba'i tshad du byed/ 'bar ba rnam gnyis su grags/ lo dgon pa btab/ sku yon mtha' yas/ stod lungs pa rin chen snying po sprul sku bya yul ba dang*/ mngar dgon pa brtson 'grus 'bar zer pa phag sgom spyan snga ba'i mnyam pa gzhir grags pa sogs su chen mang du byon/ dgung lo bdun cu don gcig bzhugs/ tshogs pa bdun brgya tsam 'dus so// dang po'i dus tsam pa chad kyin za tshod re tsam la bsten/ sham thabs la lhan pa med par kom po rgyab pas spyan snga ko sham can du grags/ da lta ni 'dzam bu gling pa kun yang ngas gsos kyang sos sam snyam gsungs/ de bzhin du mi la dang dwags po dang rgod tshangs pa la sogs pa/ dang po mi skye'i dus su sdug bsngal ci 'dra byung de nas chos la zhugs/ tshe blos gtang bas mgo nag gi mi las (463)skyid pa re byung ba de yin/ de bzhin du sngon gyi bla ma dam pa thams cad kyi rnam thar la bsams na de 'dra ma sha stag yin/

rang re rnams kyang de rnams la bsams la/ pha ngas tshe blos btang bas skyid po ma byung ba'i ga le med/ tshe blos ma thongs pa la skyid pa byung ba'i ga le mi snang na ci'i don la tshe blos mi gtong snyam bsam la/ thams cad phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin du spang bar bya ste/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i ltos thag gcad/ lto rgyab la gyong bskur/ lus srog theng la bor/ bka' rgyud rnams kyi rnam thar bsams/ ga cha dang sdug sren bskyed/ ri khrod bsten cing sgrub pa snyugs bsrings nas bsgoms pas nang nas skye tshul zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ bla ma ye dgon pa'i zhal nas/ mi zer tshad kyi 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig mang po bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar gdan du bting*/ de rnams kyi dang po'i dus nas phyis kyi bar du lag len la ci 'dra zhig bskyangs 'dug pa/ de byas na bzang ba mi bslu ba zhig 'ong ba lags so ang gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'di ma go bas bdag nyid ngan pa'i gar byed de/ tshe thung 'di la spyod pa ngan pa mi 'dra ba mang po ston pa yin gsungs/ 'di go na spyod ngan rnams mi byed par rang mgo rang gis thon pa'i 'dun ma shes pa zhig 'ong ste gsungs/ dge bshes sdings pa 'di bo to ba'i slob ma/ rus zhang pa tshab/ mtshan shes rab rgya mtsho/ sdings su gzhan don bskyangs/ dgung lo drug bcu re brgyad bzhugs so/ /pha la gdams ngag zhus dus gdams ngag med/ nga pha gtso rgan gyi bu yin pas mdun ma zhig bslab na gsungs/ skyes mchog pas kyang*/ sems la khur med bar sdod pa (464)las skyid pa med/ bya byed med par sdod pa las sla pa med/ sems gnyer med du 'jog pa las don che ba med gsungs/ sa paṇa gyi zhal nas kyang sa paṇa ni thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'jam dbyangs sogs zhal gzigs/ rgya bod thams cad du bstan pa spel/ lo bdun bcu bzhug /slob ma bshad ka 'dzin pa'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge sogs/

khang gnyan zhang gsum du grags pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin dmar chos rgyal/ lho ba kun mkhyen rin chen sogs/ rtogs pa'i rgyud 'dzin tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ grub thob yon tan mtha' yas sogs mang ngo*/ /rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste// gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin// bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa// nor gyi mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ grogs kyi mchog ni mi bslu ba'o// blo ldan tshe 'di bsgrub na yang*// chos kyi bsgrub na bde bar 'gyur// dam pa rnams dang chom rkun gyi// phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par ltos/ gsungs/ zhang btsun yeng pa'i rngo bo'i dngos slob byang chub sems dpa' zhig byon/ sku mched gsum gyi bla ma yin/ gshegs dus lha'i rol mo kun gyis tshor ba byung*/ zhal nas/ 'khyags ris shi na yang shi/ ltogs ris shi na yang shi snyam nas chos shig byas na 'khyags ris 'chi nges kyang med/ ltogs ris 'chi des kyang med gsungs/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug rgyal lha khang 'debs mkhan lung rtogs mtha' yas/ bod kyis klu mes sogs bstan pa bar dang la the/ dge bshes ston pa'i bla ma yang yin da lta bod kyi sde dgon thams cad kyi snga shos bzang shos re la the bar gda'/ dang po bla ma'i byin rlabs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par can du 'dug /

gi zhal nas kyang*/ zhag kha cig ri gseb tu ltogs par bsdas pas/ sngon la phyug rdzis (465)'jor ba ster/ de nas grong gseb pa spran nas ster du 'ong*/ gsungs/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu nga'i bstan pa ni nyes pas 'thab par mi 'gyur la/ nga'i nyan thos rnams ni chos gos dang bsod snyoms kyis dub bar mi 'gyur bas/ shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi sa la mngon par brtson par gyis shig /shā ri'i bu 'jig rten zang zing la gces par ma byed cig /shā ri'i bu ltos shig /da ni 'di skad ces rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dge slong rnams la ni lha bye ba stong phrag dag bde ba thams cad kyis stongs pas brtson par gnas ste/ shā ri'i bu mis ni de lta bu'i mchod par dang bsnyen bkur bya bar mi nus so// zhes gsungs/ shā ri'i bu gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyir rab tu byung nas chos de la yang brtson 'grus kyis gnas na/ 'dod pa chung pa'i lha rnams dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba'i mi rnams dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba'i sems can thams cad las dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ snying rje pad dkar las/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs bskyed dus bdag gi bstan pa la chos gos dur smrig sor bzhi 'chang ba'ang bza' btung bsams pa bzhin ma thob na bdag gis sangs rgyas bslus pas sangs rgyas mi thob par gyur cig /ces bshad yang khyim pa'i skye bo thams cad kun// sen mo'i steng du zhing rmod kyang*// nga yi rab tu byung ba rnams// 'tsho bas phongs par mi 'gyur ro// gsungs/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ 'o cag lto rgyab kyi 'tsho bas phongs kyang*/ blo phug sprang la gtad pas dad ldan kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas byed/ des na longs spyod kyi (466)gtso bo zhen chags med pa min pas/ ka cha'i sogs rum bya ba'i don med/

'o cag la mis 'phyar kha btang yang*/ rang sems la zol zog med pa zhig byas pas gzhug kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig yong pa yin te/ des na snyan grags kyi gzhi ma spyod lam la skyon med pa yin pas tshul 'chos bya ba'i don med gsungs/ dge bshes kha rag pa'i zhal nas/ yul gtsang stong du zhur ba/ 'phan yul spras kyi brag rgyab tu sgrub brtse gcig tu mdzad/ dge bshes dgon pa'i bu chen yin/ kha rag phug nag tu bsgoms pas kha rag sgom chung du grags/ sba sgom gyi yang slob ma yin no// slob ma rdul ston/ zangs dkar mdzod khung lhod pa dharma skyabs sogs so/ /tshe 'di'i lto gos ji ltar byas kyang phyid// shi nas byang chub 'bras bu btsal du med/ sang 'chi gnang 'chi bdag gis mi shes pas// de bas byang chub myur du btsal bar rigs// so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags kyang*// sgom chen 'khyags sam bkres nas grongs pa dag /sngon chad mthong zhing thos pa cang yod dam/ phyin chad nam yang mthong zhing thos mi 'gyur/ gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ kha ba nyin dgu mtshan dgu bab kyang*/ lcogs rang shod rnyed/ de bzhin du rgyal khams ma bde tshes 'grigs 'gribs byas kyang chos nan tar byed na gab sa dang sdod sa dang chos 'go 'don ma re rnyed gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras grub thob gling ras gyi bu chen/ 'brug dang ra lung gi dgon pa btab/ nā ro pa'i sprul par grags/ slob ma lo ras rgod tshang pa gnyis/ sa skyar gnyis/ rgya 'bras gnyis sogs mang*/ rten dge slong du bzhugs/ kyi zhal nas/ tshe blos gtong ba'i tshe 'di la ma chags pa sbyin pa'i rab/ ci byas sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba 'gro don gyi rab/ yul gang la'ang chog shes skyes pa phyug po'i rab (467)rgyal khams gar phyin yang chog ba pha yul gyi rab/ gnas gar nyal yang skyid pa gang bzang gi ri rab/ nyams myong skyo rags su bzang ba grogs po'i rab/ brtsams pa mthar 'don pa pho rgod pa'i rab/

rang dbang rang gis thob pa kha drag gi rab/ sems chags sdang gi dbang du ma shor ba snying rje'i rab/ tshul min yid la mi 'gyu ba tshul khrims kyi rab/ blo sems nyams dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro bsdud pa'i rab yin gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che ni tshe blos gtong ba sgrib pa sbyong ba'i yang mchog yin gsungs/ kun spangs grags rgyal gyi slob ma dge bshes kha rag pa bya ba yon tan dang sku bsod chen po byas pa zhig la mdze byung*/ thabs ci byas kyang ma phan/ nub gcig nad 'dis gang ltar yang mi khyun sa 'bud pa la da 'bud ngo shes pa zhig bya/ longs spyod gang yod dge phyogs la btang*/ skyid mo rdza 'phreng gi rdza 'og der bsdad la/ lto la lam zan slong*/ ma ṇi 'dren snyam pa byung*/ de nub rmi lam na khong chus khyer bas/ mi dkar po zhig gis chu nas bton skyi mo rdza 'phreng gi brag steng du bzhag pas/ lus las chu mang po zags pa rmis/ sad tsa na mal chus khengs/ mdze sangs phan zer gsungs/ tshe blos gtang ba 'di nyams rtogs ma skyes pa skyes pa dang*/ skyes pa mi nyams par gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thabs nyag gcig yin te/ grub chen yu mo ba'i zhal nas/ nyams la yar skyed med pa de// zla ba nyi mas non pa 'dra// de gnyis snang gi yul la zhen pas lan// sems 'khri ba chod cig skal ldan kun/ gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ sgom skyes bdag po med pa de// phyug po rlung gis khyer ba 'dra// seng ge khyi yi zla la shor// nor bu rin (468)chen 'dam du bying*// des na zhen log bdag po dgos// gsungs/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa mtha' dag log pa zhig byung na/ chos gzhan thams cad la dga' ba med par kha spos pas chog pa zhig yod la/ 'di med na nyams rtogs kun yong yong 'dra 'dug kyang myur du nyams 'gro ba mang du mthong zhing thos la rigs pas kyang grub/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas kyang*/ tshe 'di'i bdar sha ma chod na// dad pa'i nyams dang ting nge 'dzin// gong ma skye ba bzhin 'dug kyang*// dus tshod gcig na nyams nas 'gro// 'di gcig byung na brtan pa yin// chos rnams rgyud la skye ba dang*// gnas dang gong nas gong du 'phel// blo skyed kun kyang nam mkha' yi// dkyil nas 'thon pa bzhin du 'ong*// dper na sa bon mar 'dzugs bzhin// 'di zug yar gyi blo skyed drag

/gsungs/ kha cig chos snying nas byed 'dod kyi dad pa dang*// zhen log dang blo chod re che byas/ sdod tshugs zin zin po yong yong 'dra yod tsa na/ ting nge 'dzin bzang bzang po zhig ma byung bas yi mug nas/ nga 'dras chos byas kyang nus pa mi 'thon pa snang snyam nas bshol btong ste/ de ni gtsang pa rgya ras gsung ba bzhin sgom skyes bdag po med pa/ seng ge khyi'i zla la shor ba rang yin te/ sngar mang du bshad pa ltar gyi blo ma skyes na ni bde dge gang yang yong pa med/ skyes na ni bde dge thams cad yid bzhin du thob pa'i zhen log gi blo sna/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyis rab tu bsngags pa skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la 'byung bar dka' ba 'di 'dra nyag nyug byung dus dga' ba bsgom/ sgyid pa bgrad nas mi sdod pa ni bsod nams dman pa rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa yin te/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ so (469)med kyang rnyil gyis 'drad zer ba bzhin/ blo chos la 'gror mi nyan yang*/ nga ci tsug song yang chos byed zer ba zhig byung na/ blo skyed byung ba dang chos byung ba de dag yin/ tshe 'dir smon pa man chod sems sbyong*// de gong sa bon tsam zhig 'debs shing*/ de sbyong smon lam rtag tu 'debs na/ phyag rgya che thob bzhin du don che/ zhes tshe 'dir zhen log gam mi rtag pa la blo sbyong ba nas/ smon pa sems bskyed man chod la blo sbyong ba la bsgril nas/ de gong zhi gnas lhag mthong sogs ma skyes kyang sa bon tsam 'debs/ smon lam 'debs bzhin pa zhig gi ngang la shi na phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang thob pa bzhin du don che/ bsod nams che dang chung pa'i khyad par// zang zing mang dang nyung bas ma yin// rang rgyud phyin kyi ma log shes pa// skye dang mi skyed gnyis khyad yin// zhes tshe 'di'i phun tshogs mang ba bsod nams can min/ zhen log sogs phyin ci ma log pa'i shes pa skyes na bsod nams can yin gsungs/

be'u bum sngon por/ rgyal sras rin pos ches kyang*/ blo rgyud chos su 'gro na tshogs bsags mthar thug yin/ nam 'chi nges med dran na sbyang po'i mthar thug yin/ sdig spang dge ba bsgrub na grub pa'i mthar thug yin/ 'gro kun spyi bor khur na mthon po'i mthar thug yin/ chog shes blo dang ldan na phyug po'i mthar thug yin/ gang la'ang chags zhen med na skyid pa'i mthar thug yin/ gsungs/ de ltar bsams pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa thams cad la zhen pa log /de 'phel bas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log pa zhig byung na/ de can thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de med na ci yod kyang lam sna mi zin/ de byung na gzod chos (470)chos pa'i khyur tshud pa lags so// tshe blos gtang ba'i phan yon dang*/ ma btang ba'i nyes dmigs ni de 'dra na/ 'o na tshe blos gtong lugs ji ltar bya snyam na/ de la gtsang pa rgya ras gyi zhal nas/ tshe blos gtong ba la dam tshig 'di rnams dgos gsungs/ mi dang blo sna mi bstun par gcig pur sdod pa dang*/ pha yul spong ba dang*/ 'dod yon la yi mug 'ba' zhig sgom pa dang*/ dma' sa 'dzin cing su yi yang ngo me bsrung ba dang*/ gnyen po zlog sgom gyi bya ra 'jog pa dang*/ mi zer la ched du mi 'dzin par zer mod 'dug mod du 'jog pa dang*/ gces dgu rlung gis khyer yang sdug bsngal mi byed pa dang*/ sprang po shi ba bzhin mi tshe sdug zad la gtong ba dang*/ dgos med kyi drag sngags rgyun du bgrang ba dang*/ rang gi sna thag rang gis 'dzin pa dang*/ nyams len bzang po sprin bzhin 'khor bar bya ba dang*/ bcu gcig po 'di yin gsungs/ gzhan yang tshe bos gtong ba la mi rgyud la snying rus dang gcod khams che ba rdo bcag pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'phral bde la gting gcu dka' ba g.yag rgan gyi 'jing pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'du 'dzi la 'jigs pa sha ba rdzi phog pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ rtsis gdab med pa nyes can g.yangs la mchongs pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/

sdug thub pa yugs mo dwa phrug bsrel ba 'dra ba zhig dgos gsungs/ spyir 'dod pa spong ba'i 'dod pa la 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas/ dngos po'i 'dod pa dang nyon mongs pa'i 'dod pa gnyis yod de/ 'di gnyis char rab tu byung bas spang gsungs/ dngos po'i 'dod pa ni yul dang zhing dang khang pa dang*/ pha ma la sogs pa'i nye 'brel dang nor 'bru la sogs pa'i yongs su bzung ba thams cad (471)spang nas rab tu byung ba de/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhes pa'i don yang de dag la zer/ da ltar tshe blos gtong tshul ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba tshang mas byed pa yin na/ byed lugs gang 'dra byed bltas pa rang gis shes te/ 'on kyang da ltar gyi gang zag blo dman pa la so sor phye ste ma bshad na mi go bas/ sngar gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gsung pa bzhin du bshad na/ tshe blos gtong ba la bslab bya bcu dgu yod pa las/ dang po pha yul spong ba 'di gal che ste/ de na zhen chags skye ba'i yul nye 'brel dang zhing khang la sogs pa'i nor rdzas dang*/ sdang sems skye ba'i yul dgra la sogs pa yod pas/ blo chags sdang gi dbang du shor nas chos mi 'grub/ gal te rang la chags sdang ma byung yang de rnams kyis tshur la chags sdang byed du 'ong ste/ nye 'brel gyis khong tsho'i tshe 'di'i chos kyi grogs 'chol/ gal te ma byas na sdig gsog /dgras sngar gyi 'khon tsam yid la byas nas sgo gsum gyis ci gnod byed/ rang gzhan la sdig sdug bskyed pa yin/ pha yul spangs na de 'dra'i skyon med pa lags te/ po to ba'i gsungs las/ skyes pa'i yul spangs te dus thag pa spongs/ 'du 'dzi kun spangs tshul bzhin yid byed/ de la thar pa ring ba ma yin/ gsungs/ skyes pa'i yul spangs/ nye du dang 'brel ba gcod/ ma brtags pa'i dngos po thams cad spong ba dang gsum po ni/ rwa sgreng ba'i bka' srol yin pa la/

phyis kyi mi kun gyis 'di dka' bar byung gsungs/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdor yang*/ gang na'ang spros pa'am rtsod pa yod pa las// dpag tshad (472)brgya yi pha rol 'gro ba mchog /gang na nyon mongs yod pa de dag tu// yud tsam zhig kyang gnas shing 'dug mi bya// rab byung don 'dod yon tan 'dod pa rnams// sdang ba'i sems kyis rtsod par ma byed cig /khyed la zhing med zhing las 'tshong bya med// gang dag nor phyir 'di dag 'byung ba smros// khyed la chung ma bu dang bu mo med// khyim dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyang yod ma yin// bran pho bran mo med cing dbang phyug med// gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas kyang*// nyon mongs yul las skye ba la// pha yul mi spang ba'i snying med po// nyams len gnyen pos byed pa la// gnyen po mi bsten pa'i snying med po// chos bshad rkyen gyis 'byed pa la// rkyen dang mi sprod pa'i snying med po// skyes pa'i pha yul spong pa dang*// rlung khyer zer yang 'gyod pa med// spong thag bla ma'i phyogs su thong dang*// ltogs nas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ skam thag chu nang du chod dang*// bla ma bsten yun thung zer yang 'gyod pa med// skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bor dang*/ gnyen po'i rten 'brel des 'grig /'jig rten gyi bde 'bras byur du mthong na/ dad pa'i rten 'brel des 'grog /'jig rten blos thongs dang*// sbyin pa'i rten 'brel des 'grig /skyes pa'i pha yul ma spangs na chags sdang rgyun mi chad pa yin pas skyes pa'i pha yul spongs shig /'jig rten gyi bya ba ma btang na dge sbyor gyi so bsod mi 'byung bas/ bya ba thong zhig nor rdzas rlung la ma bskur na nye 'brel gyi kho thag mi chod pas/ nor rdzas rlung la bskur cig /gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ gnyen gyi (473)phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo// dgra yi phyogs la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar// blang dor brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can// pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/

gsungs/ rje re mda' ba'i mtshan gzhon nu blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin brnyes/ lo tsā ba byang rtse sogs kyi bu chen no// slob ma rje tsong kha pa sogs kun mkhyen bdun du grags pa sogs thon no// zhal nas/ gang du gnas na snang shas 'phel 'gyur zhing*/ rang rgyud rnyed bkur zhags pas 'ching byed la// gzhan rgyud phrag dog 'gran sems kyis gdung ba'i// gnas der skad cig tsam yang mi gnas so// gsungs/ 'ba' ra ba'i zhal nas/ dus ngan sems can tshor ngan che// khyim mtshes mdo gnon ci gnod bskyel// 'dzur med hor khral cha ma mang*// sne mkhan go mtshams stongs dus med// dus ngan pha yul bzung ba dka' bar gda'// sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims// rang yul chags sdang skye bar shes lags kyang*// 'phral gang mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i mi gnyis chags// rang 'thad dben par sgom pa nam yod na// skyid chos mkhan la bla ma'i thugs rjes zungs/ gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang gi nye du'i bkur sti rab spangs nas// gzhan gyi bkur sti 'dod na blos btang snyoms// yul dang gnyen bshes longs spyod kun spangs nas// snyan grags 'dod pa'i blo yis bcings gyur na// lcags sgog chod nas srad bus 'khyigs pa yin/ gsungs pa ltar pha yul min yang rang gzhan nyon mongs 'phel na yul gang yin kyang spangs nas gnas nges med bya dgos te/ po to (474)ba'i zhal nas/ spyod pa bsod snyoms skye ba bskyal bya// 'dod chung bstan bya sems kyis mi gdung*// nyi zla bzhin du kun tu rgyu bya// yul gcig mi sdod gnas gcig ma bzung*// grogs dang sbyin bdag yul ring chad yin// gnya' sha su la'ang sbyin par mi bya/ zhes dang*/ bsdad na 'phongs rjes/ 'gron rkang rjes las med pa/ lha ma sna bsgyur na ban gzhis rdzogs par dgos/ 'gron dngos po 'di dang 'di'i 'chol ba sod byed/
'di dang 'di khal la 'gal dgos zer ba des mi yong*// chos dang 'gal 'gal dus gcig tu bsdad pas mi yong*/ sdig gsog na 'gro dgos pa yin/ chos shor na yul ma shor yang phan med/ zla ba sgron me'i

ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang gcig /mdor yang*/ gang la rtag tu bdag gir byed pa med// gang la yongs 'dzin rnam pa kun tu med// bse ru lta bur 'jig rten 'dir gnas pa// de dag nam mkha' la ni rlung ltar 'gro// bya ba dang*/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ nyi ma phyed nas bsod nyoms mchog /bslangs nas sang gir mi byed par// lto 'grangs tsam gyis chog byed pa// de lta bu ni dge slong yin// gsungs/ de 'dra zhig yin na chos la gnod ma thag nas lang 'gro nus pa zhig yod gsungs/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub dpal rnams bsams sding sa btab/ nā ro dang ni gu'i chos drug la gtso bor mang dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i khyad par can zhig byon no/ /kyi zhal nas/ gnas gcig yun ring chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu// 'dris bshes mang na phyogs ris zhen pa 'phel// gsog rum mang pos lus ngag dge sbyor cog /'khrungs ba yub gdong*/ 'dris (475)med yul du 'khyams na mi 'thad dam// sha tsha'i gtams yin rang gi snying la dris/ gsungs/ yang*/ 'gro 'dug mang po 'gyod rgyu yin// 'dug sa non pa dge sbyor 'phel/ bya ba dang*/ 'pho skyas mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ ces kyang 'byung bas/ 'gro'am sdod gang 'thad dge sbyor 'phel mi 'phel la brtags nas byed pa yin te/ po to ba'i gsung las/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul dang grogs ni// byang chub sems kyis 'phang pa'i bslab gsum// gang du gnas pas 'phel ba de yul// gang dang 'grogs pas 'phel ba de grogs// de las ldog pa yul dang grogs min/ zhes dang*/ me la tswa shing gi dmag drangs med nga rtsa shing ma 'tshams pas/ rtswa shing gis dpung bsags/ der me la kho dbung gsog gin 'dug byas pas/ khong dpung ji ltar che ba tsam gyis nga'i grogs yin zer/ pa bzhin du sdug bsngal dang gnod pa ci byung yang chos la mi gnod kyi steng du grogs su 'gro na yul de spangs mi dgos gsungs/

༈ gnyis pa nye du spongs pa ni/ gnas gong du yin yang nye du dang 'brel thag chad pa gal che ste/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ mi chos la yi mug sgom na 'brel thag chod pa'i rtags yin/ mi chos la drin du gzon chags sdang gi 'dam du bying ba'i rtags yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya byed thams cad 'khrul par go na zhen pa log pa'i rtags yin/ thams cad bden mug sgom na 'brel thag chod pa'i rtags yin/ mi chos la drin du gzo na chags sdang gi 'dam du bying ba'i rtags yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya byed thams cad la 'khrul par go na zhen pa log pa'i rtags yin/ thams cad bden par go na bde sbyor dred pa'i rtags yin/ gsungs/ nye 'brel spong ba yang*/ sems can blos spong du ma song ba byas nas snying rje ni bya dgos la/ lus longs spyod kyi 'brel thag gcod dgos te/ de ltar ma byas na (476)chos mi 'grub pas so// 'brel thag gcod pa na pha ma la sogs pa la zhus pas khrol na ni legs/ bsdigs mo dang yi chad 'khong ra sogs ci byed kyang dpa' zhum pa med par bya ste/ sngon bcom ldan 'das nas bzung ste/ chos mdzad thams cad kyang nye du rnams mig mchims gang bzhin du bskyur nas byon pa 'di rten 'brel gyi che ba lta bur 'dug pas so// rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ nye du la sogs brtse bas tshe 'di yi// phun tshogs sgrub la nan gyis bskul byed ma// phan par 'dod nas gnod la sbyong byed pa'i// blun po tshe 'di don gnyer de dag nying*// thar bar bya phyir tshe 'di blos gtang nas// zab me'i lam la 'bad par bya dgos pas// de dag don du de dag rab spangs nas// dben par sgrub la brtson pa shin tu gces// 'byor pa'i tshe na bros kyang rjes su snyegs// rgud pa'i tshe na drung du bsnyegs kyang 'bros// bu yis rang gis pha yang gsod byed na// nye du rnams la su zhig yid brtan byed// mngon du gyur na dga' ba'i tshul ston cing*// lkog tu gyur na mi snyan sna tshogs sgrogs// phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel byed pa'i// byis pa'i grogs po mdza' yang nges par bslu// 'byor tshe bzhin 'dzum kha gsag sna tshogs kyis// bdag gi 'byor pa thabs kyis 'bral byed cing*// rgud na bzhin bsdus 'thab cing cung zad kyang*// phan med gnyen bshes skyong ba 'khrul par zad// gnyen mang dar ba sdong nas pha rol 'dzoms// so sor gyes na nang du chags sdang byed// gal la bab na pha bu phan tshun gsod// gnyen gyis phan bde 'grub pa shin tu dkon// gsungs/

kha rag pa'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i pha ma bu tsha (477)dang*// gnyen gzhi rtsa lag thams cad kun// mgron po gnas mthun tshogs pa 'dra// 'brel med yid la gyis shig ang*// gsungs/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ 'dod yon dgra po'i dwangs ma 'dra// nye 'brel 'ching ba'i zhags pa 'dra// che 'dod 'gong po phugs zhugs 'dra// snang shas ma che rgya ma pa// gsungs/ skyes mchog pa'i mtshan bsam gtan dpal/ zhi byed pa rgya grags chos rje'i slob ma zhi byed la gtso bor mdzad/ sgo mo dang ya ba btab/ ting nge 'dzin brnyes par grags/ zhal nas/ yul pha yul gyi steng nas chags sdang 'byung*// pho skyo shas can yod na tur thon mdzod// gnyen nye 'brel gyi steng nas gdung sems 'byung*// pho chos mdzad po yong na gdong chung mdzod// nor dngos po'i steng nas gsog 'jog 'byung*// pho zhen logs po yod na nang yan mdzod// zas zhim mngar gyi steng nas 'dod sred 'byung*/ pho zhe bcad can yod na dka' thub mdzod// mgu ba med pa'i nye 'brel 'di// bskyangs kyin skyong dgos je mang 'gro// gdung sems 'brel thag bcad na legs// snying gtam yin gyi sems la zhog /gsungs/ 'ba' ra ba'i zhal nas/ gnyen nye 'brel nye ring mnyam lags kyang*// 'byor ldan kha so ngo lag blta// dbul zhing phongs pa byur du mthong*// 'khos med mi mthong mtho kha 'grim// dus ngan gnyen zla spongs par dka'// gsungs/ ༈ gsum pa g.yog 'khor spangs pa ni/ de bzhin du g.yog 'khor dang bu slob la sogs pa'i zhen chags spong bar byas te/ spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams la chags byas na// yang (478)dag nyid la kun nas sgrib// skyo ba'i sems kyang 'jig par byed// tha mar mya ngan gdung bar 'gyur// de la sems pa 'ba' zhig gis// tshe 'di don med bda' bar 'gyur// skad cig gcig gis mdza' 'gyur la// yud tsam zhig gis dgrar yang 'gyur// dga' ba'i gnas la khro byed pa// so so skye bo mgu ba dka'// phan par smras na khro bar byed// bdag kyang phan las ldog par byed// de dag ngag ni mi mnyan na// khro bas ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur// de ltar bdag gis gzhan bsten pa// de ni 'phung bar 'gyur zad na// des kyang bdag don ma byas la// bdag kyang de don mi 'gyur bas// byis las thag ring 'byol bar bya// zhes gsungs/

tshoms su/ rnam pa kun tu dgra 'dra ba'i// byis dang 'grogs pa sdug bsngal zhing*// byis pa ma thos ma mthong zhing*// ma bsten gyur pa nyid rung ngo*// gsungs// chos rje bus// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mang pos ma thul zhing*// mthu chen rgyal sras kun gyis ma thul pa// smad na khong khro bstod na dregs pa skye// mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can// dma' la nga rgyal rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba// chos mthun tshig gis smras kyang chags sdang byed// byis pa'i skye bo 'di 'dra bdag gis ni// da lta 'dul bar mi nus rang sems thul// gzhan don chos kyi gtso bor gsung pa yang*// gdul bya'i dbang po khams dang bag la nyal// tshong dang sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes kyang*// rang don ma chags gdul bya gdul la dgongs// rang nyid rnyed grags bde bstod don gnyer bas// mngon shes (479)med par gzhan don byed pa ni// gshog pa med par mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin// gzhan don mi 'grub rang don nyams pa'i rgyu// bshad nyan bstan pa 'dzin par gsungs pa yang*// nges 'byung rnam dag khrims la brten byas nas// gnyen po gzur nas don gnyer blo ldan la// mkhas pas sde snod 'chad la dgongs pa yin// tshe 'di'i rnyed grags 'dod pas 'khor bsdus te// ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du chos 'chad cing*// nyams len mi byed chags snang skyed pa'i rgyu// 'chad nyan 'di yang 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin/ zhes gsungs// gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas// skyid 'dod na gcig pur sdod// bza' che na che ste su dang yang bgod mi dgos// med na med de su yang skyong dgos kyi sems khral med pas skyid/ 'khyags rung ltogs rung gcig pu yin pas skyid gsungs/ de thugs med de// thams cad skyid sdug ni nor dang dngos po'i steng nas 'jog par snang la/ grwa pa mi gcig la nor bun len dgos pa ni srid mtha' yin/ mi mang po la bun len mi dgos pa ni srid mtha' tsam du snang ba de yin// dge bshes kha rag bas/
