dad gus kyi 'khor las dgon pa med/ mi ngan gyi dpon las sdug pa med/ bzang po'i dpon la ma 'dzin par// ngan pa'i dman sa zungs shig ang*// zhes dang*/ snying ring dka' blo mi bde rang 'dod can// zag pa 'phel ba'i 'khor g.yog med kyang legs// kho bo'i nye gnas brtson 'grus shes rab yin// dgos pa'i don kun sgrub la skyo ngal med/ gsungs/ 'ba' rabs/ nor dang kha drag yod ce na// mgo (480)dag gi mi 'dis gang bcol nyan// phan gnod nus pa med tsa na// drin gyis bskyangs pas zhor la brnyas// dus ngan 'khor gyis phan pa dka'// rang gcig pu'i g.yos bskol sus kyang shes// 'bral med kyi nye gnas lag pa bzang*// tshul 'chos kyi bzang tshul mi dgos phar// rang gcig pu'i spyod pa bag re yangs// dka' thub kyi zas la zad pa med// rang gcig pu'i 'tsho ba gar yang rnyed// rang gcig pu'i gos 'di cis kyang dro// gtum mo'i me 'di gting drod che// rang gcig pu'i sdod pa 'di cis kyang mchog /bdag med kyi spyil bu snang ba bde/ gsungs/ ༈ bzhi pa bshad nyan dang lung khrid la sogs pa'i gzhan don ltar snang rnams spong ba ni/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ 'o cag sgom chen pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na// dug po brtse mas ber re gyon/ a ru ra'i phreng ba re thogs/ sgom khang bye'u'i rjes bkra lam me sgom du yod pa'i dus su mi phan nges pa'i brtson chung rnams la chos bshad byed pa 'di yang dge bshes pa dgyer chen po mi gsungs te/ nga ni de yang smyo ba yin nam snyam gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ sa bon ma btab pa'i ston thog re ba ltogs 'gong yin/ dus la ma bab pa'i 'gro don re ba'o brgyal ba yin gsungs/ po to pa'i gsungs nas// de ltar rang rgyud yongs su smin pa// las dang po yis gtso bor de bya/ gzhan don gtso bor bya ba ma gnang sems kyis sems can don las gzhan med// lus dang ngag gis dngos su mi 'jug

/gsungs/ khro los/ gtan gyi rang 'gros ma shes na// ji (481)tsam gzhan gyis dpon bcol yang*// don la gla mid kyi khol po yin// ming stong snyoms po 'di a tsam/ gsungs/ rje re mda' bas/ chos brgyad rkyen gyis nam yang mi g.yo ba'i// sems la brten pa ji srid ma thob bar/ gcig tu rang rgyud 'dul ba ma gtogs par// gzhan don thabs kyis rang don nyams mi bgyid/ gsungs/ ༈ lnga pa rnyed pa dang bkur sti spong ba ni/ tshe blos gtong ba la rnyed bkur spong ba gal che ste/ lhag bsam bskul ba las/ byams pa 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni nyes dmigs/ 'dod chags bskyed pa yin par brtag par bya'o// rnyed dang bskur sti ni dran nyes pa de tshol bas sngar gyi thos pa brjed pas/ pa 'joms par byed pa brtag par bya'o// rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pas nga rgyal gyis khengs pa dang 'dud sems zhum pas/ par brtag par bya'o// de bzhin du sbyar te sngar gyi gsol 'debs pas/ gti mug bskyed pa dang*/ bdag tshe 'di'i gi don sgrub pas nye du'am yon bdag gi/ khyim la ser sna byed pa dang*/ 'chags par byed pa dang*/ g.yo gzhan bslu ba'am tshul 'chos/ sgyu bskyed pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi 'am dge slong gi chos bzhi/ yongs su spong bas rang gi ngo tsha mi shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis khrel med pa bskyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma gzhan don ma btags pas gnang ba dang*/ nga rgyal dang sems kyis rgyags pa dang lus ngag gi dregs pa bskyed pa dang*/ rang la nged pa byung tsa na/ bla ma rnams la khyad du gsod pa dang*/ nyon (482) mongs pa'i bdud kyi phyogs yin pa dang*/ gcig tu dge ba mi sgom pa dang mi dge ba mi spong ba bag med pa'i rtsa ba yin pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phrog pa dang*/ de la dngos por zhen pas gti mug bskyed pas dge ba gsum 'phrog go

/ glog mi rtag pa'i dpe gsum dang 'khor lo dang*/ lce 'bab thog pa lta bu dang*/ sbags nyon mongs pa'i pa mang pos sbags pa dang*/ mdza' bshes kyi khyim dang*/ rnyed bkur byung na chags/ ma byung na zhe sdang*/ /slong mo ster ba'i khyim yon bdag gi la blta ba dang zhen pas yid mi bde rnyed pa yang ma rnyed pas kyang*/ pa bskyed pa dang*/ blo rnam ma rab mtho sar ston ma rmi lam dang 'dra bar par 'khrul par byed pa dang*/ phyi nang gi sdug pa'i dngos po rnams 'gyur bar med pa/ byed pa'i phyir sems la/ mya ngan bskyed pa dang*/ dran lus tshor sems chos/ pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi brjed par byed pa dang*/ dkar po'i chos sgrub pa/ nyams chung bar byed pa dang*/ yang sdig pa skyes pa spong ba// dge ba ma skyes pa skyed pa sogs/ dag pa spong ba bzhi yongs su nyams par byed pa dang*/ rdzu gyi rkang pa bzhi/ 'phrul dang mngon par shes lnga'am drug pa yongs su nyams par byed pa dang*/ sngar bkur sti byed la phyis bkur sti mi byed par byed pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba mthun par dang gnas par byed pa dang*/ mdza' ma ster na/ bo spong ba dang*/ pha rol brid pa'i rol mo'i gtso mo/ smad 'tshong ma dang 'dra ba dang*/ bsam gtan dang tshad med pa bzhi spong ba dang*/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du lhung bar byed par dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni lhas (483)byin dang*/ lhag spyod kyi ston pa gzhan dang lam gzhan/ chog spyod pa/ dang mthun par brtag par shes par bya'o// byams pa byang chub sems dpas rnyed pa dang bkur sti la nyes dmigs gang brtag par bya ba ni 'di lta bu 'di dag go /brtags de la brtags pas ci la phan zhe na/ nas 'dod ma thob pa la/ pa chung bar bya'i yongs sems rnyed bkur gyis/ su gdung ba ni mi bya'o// de ci'i gdung bar mi bya ba/ phyir zhe na/ byams pa 'dod pa chung ba la gong du bshad pa'i

skyon 'di lta bu 'di dag med pa'i phyir te/ de'i 'dod pa chung ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rgyu dang 'bras bu'i/ rnams la bar chad med pa yin/ khyim pa dang rab byung dag gi yid ma dad pa mi skye bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba yin/

lha dgos pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ dang mi rnams bsam pa/ yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas pas rjes 'gal rkyen/ su bsrung bar 'os pa yin/ ngan 'gro logs par ltung ba thams cad kyis skrag pa med pa yin/ bsdigs rnyed pa mi ster ba dang 'phrogs pas/ pa dang bral bas gzhan gyis/ zil gyis mi gnon pa yin/ bdud bar du gcod pa'i kyi yul las yongs su grol bas dge ba mi 'phrog pa yin/ sdug ma rnyed pa'i bsngal thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa yin/ lha dang mi rnams kyi yid du 'ong bas mngon par 'dod par bya ba yin/ bsam 'jig rten dang 'das pa'i gtan la goms par byed par gnas pas gsal sems dmigs pa la ba yin/ g.yo bcas la nye bar sgrub pa spang na sems gya gyu mi drang ba/ dang sgyu spangs gzhan bslu ba dang gzhan du sma zhing gzhan du sems pa/ pa dang (484)'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la skyon du blta bas bag yod pa yin/ dge ba sgom pa dang mi dge ba spong bar rang gi sems 'dul ba bzhin gyi sems bslu ba dbang po'i sgo sdom par byed pa'o/ 'phags pa'i rigs la gnas de btsun/ pas ji skad smras pa de bzhin du dam bca' brtan par byed pa yin/ gsung rabs la mkhas pa rnams dang tshangs par mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam bslab pa gsum la mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis yid du 'ong zhing bsten 'dod pa yin/ byams pa phan yon bcu gnyis po 'di lta bu 'di dag shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pas rnyed pa dang bkur sti thams cad spang ba'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas 'dod pa chung ba la bsten par bya'o// zhes gsungs/ ༈ drug pa yo byad gsog rum spang ba ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches chos pa'i gol sa yin pas tshe 'di'i che thabs spongs/ rnyed bkur 'ching byed yin pas 'dod yon 'khri ba chod// snyan grags snying po med pas de la zhan pa spongs gang byung tsam gyis chog shes blo med na// longs spyod bsags pa sdug sdig 'phel ba'i rgyu// bde dang dge ba ngang gis 'phel byed na// chog shes blo sna bsten pa man ngag yin// des na rnyed bkur grags sogs tshe 'di yi// phun tshogs sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor yongs spangs nas// 'chi tshe nges par phan pa dam chos la// g.yel ba med par rtag tu 'bad par bya/

gsungs/ skyes mchog pas/ sgyu ma'i nor la chog shes med// zhes pas bsags kyang shul du lus// rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod// snying gtam yin gyi sems la zhog /phugs kyi 'dod blo mi gda' ste// 'phral dgos blo yis ma (485)thengs pas// zhen pa zlog pa dka' mor gda'// 'dzin pa thongs par byin gyis rlobs// grags pas 'khor slob ma bsdus kyang*// dang ldan skyur ba ma phod pas// bya btang byed pa dka' mor gda'// grogs med gcig pur byin gyis rlobs/ rje re mda' bas// chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed la sogs pa// rang nyid 'tsho ba'i yo byad ma gtogs pa// gser dang dbyig sogs ldag pa'i dngos po ni// rang gi don du til tsam mi 'chang ngo*// gsungs/ 'ba' ra ba'i zhal nas/ bsags pa sus khyer cha med mthong lags kyang*// da dung sbyin pa gtong ba'i blo med pas// 'dod yon 'khri ba chod pa nam yong na// gling bzhi'i nor la dbang bsgyur kyang*// med kyin chad pa ma gtogs pa// ldang zhing lhag pa yongs dus med// dbang che bas 'phrog cing chung bas rku// dus ngan nor rdzas thub pa dka' bar gda'/ gsungs/ ༈ bdun pa gza' btung la zhen pa spangs pa ni/ spyir nor sogs rum byed pa ni bza' btung la sred pa dang*/ ltogs 'khyags nas shi dogs dang*/ bla ma mchod pa byed pa sogs 'dod pa dang*/ 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs ma go bas len la/ bza' btung la zhen pa ni mi rigs te/ po to ba'i drung na/ lto gdungs nan ltar che ba la chos ma byung bar byed/ lto phyir gnam rdib pa la chos lar mi yongs gsungs/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis// lus ngag tshul 'chos log 'tsho 'byung ba'i rgyu// dad zas ma ngan dge sbyor 'grib pa'i rkyen// ro zhim zas kyi 'khri ba rtsad bcad nas// lto gos (486)gyang la bskur na mi 'thad dam/ gsungs/ khro phub bsod nams seng ges// dad ldan mos pas 'tsho ba sbyar byas te// bzang por bskur ba'i tshul 'chos spyod pa yang*// gzhan sems bsrung phyir bdag nyid 'ching ba'i rgyu// ro snyoms spyod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/

gsungs/ sngar dge bshes ston pa dang rnal 'byor pa rnams pa bzhi sogs rwa sgreng du phebs lan/ tsha ba gsol zin nas dro la gsol rgyu ye ma lus pa byung*/ da ji ltar bya glengs pas/ dgon pa bas nga ni sus sna gdong na yar 'ong ba 'di za gsungs/ mngon shes gsung ma khad la yon bdag gcig gis zhabs tog gi chas khyer slebs byung*// dge bshes ston pa yon tan sbed pa la thugs dgyes pas bka' bkyon/ dgon pa ba phyis cher gsungs/ sngon gyi bka' gdams pa dam pa kun yon tan sbed pa la gtso bor mdzad/ yon tan sbas pas bdud mi 'jug gsungs/ lar na dam pa nyams 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba mi mdzad dka' thub la dgyes gsungs/ spyan snga kun gyis tshe stong za tshod re tsam la brten pa sogs ltogs rgur la mi tshe bskyal/ na bza' la lhan pa med par kom po rgyab pas spyan snga ko sham can du grags/ gang gi'ang rtsol ba spangs te bsgoms pas 'jig rten tha snyad rnams kyang brjed song 'dug /gsungs skad/ de bzhin du mi las lo dgu/ rmog cog pas lo bcu gnyis su za tshod tsam la brten pa sogs bshes gnyen dam pa thams cad de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /brgyad pa longs spyod 'bad med du 'byung ba'ang dwang du mi blang ba ni/ de ltar spong bar byed pa la byung na mi dgag /ma byung na mi sgrub zer (487)bas mi 'ong ste/ mdor gang pos zhus pa'i yang*/ bdag ni dbang phyug mi 'tshol gyi// gal te rnyed par spong par byed// deng 'dir sangs rgyas chos zab dang*// tshul khrims rnams dag 'ba' zhig 'chol/ zhes dang*/ gnyen po bsten pa bas yul ngan spong ba dga' zhes pa ltar nyon mongs skye ba'i yul tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams song dgos zhes sngar yang mang du bshad cing*/ po to ba'i gsung las/ 'jig rten chos kyi mi 'dod bzhi ldan// rnam srol sgrub pas de ni 'dam bya// ma tshor gter la gnod pa med cing*// tshor tshor ba de nyid

na gzhan gyis 'khyer ba de nyid// rnyed bsnyen pa dang*/ bstod pa bde ba ste/ sogs bzhi po gzhan la snang yang*// de nyid shi zin 'dra bar shes bya// mdo khams jo bos sbrang ma lag par khyer ba la sbrang ma gcig 'dus gnyis 'dus mang du 'dus nas de zos pas zad so skad/ de bzhin du rnyed pa sogs la dgra 'dre 'du ba'o// blangs bzhin/ de bas rnyed sogs bzhi la dgrar bzung*// mnga' thang mtha' rgyas sdug bsngal mtsho rdol// man ngag las kyang 'byung de ltar shes bya/ zhes dang*// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis// des pa bdog mang ji ltar sdug bsngal ba/ 'dod pa chung rnams de ltar ma lags te// klu mchog rnams la mgo bo ji snyed pa// de las byung ba'i sdug bsngal de skyed do// gsungs/ po to ba'i gsung las/ snyod na bu chung yang za/ phul na 'phags pa yang bzhes zer bas mi yong*/ 'phags pa phul yang mi bzhes pa zhig dgos gsungs/ ༈ dgu pa mthun 'jug dang ngo bsrung (488)spong ba ni/ dge bshes phu chung ba'i sku mched gsum gyi gcig yin/ khong gis gdul bya ma bskyang sha gzugs rang gsol/ grub thob kyi rnam pa chen po zhig byon par snang*/ chos 'brel re tsam yod pa ni ches mang bar snang*/ rus zur tshang pa mtshan gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ ston pa lo bcu gcig bsten gsum pa'am bsten yun ring shos/ spya snga bas lo dgu/ po to bas bdun bsten/ bdun bcu rtsa drug la do bo dgon par sku 'das/ khams lung pa dang bzhi la bka' gdams bzhi po zhes zer ba lags so/ zhal nas/ chos nan tar nyams su len na/ dper na khrab kyi byang bu sna tshe 'ol ba de khrab kyi gseb tu sdebs su mi gtub pa ltar/ tshe 'di pa'i mi dang sdeb tu mi gtub pa zhig dgos/ mthun 'jug dang mi dga' chos ni bdud kyis 'khyer/ mi ma mgu ba 'dod thogs yin/ kho ma mgu bas kho rang mi 'ong*/ khos 'phyar kha btang bas gzhan mi 'ong*/ de tsa na rgyags phye zho re las med kyang de'i bar la blo sems bde 'bol le dge sbyor byar yod/

dge sbyor 'phel na gzhan don yar lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ chags sdang rtsa ba pha yul spangs// sdug bsngal rtsa ba khyim thab spangs// 'dzin chags rtsa ba nor rdzas spangs// g.yeng ba'i rtsa ba ngo bsrung spangs/ gsungs/ khro phu ba bsod nams seng ges/ grogs dang dgon pa ri khrod la sogs pa// gang du sdod kyang dgos mdza' mi 'tshol zhing*// su dang 'grogs kyang mi mdza' mi 'khon par// rang tshugs 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin// nang du sdod tshe khang pa'i bkod la sogs// dben pa'i khong nas (489)phud chags sgrub pa yang*// don chung las la mi tshe zad pa'i rgyu// bya ba gtong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin// gsungs/ mkhas btsun pas/ ja chang thabs ka'i sems 'dzin la sogs pa// dkar po dge ba'i chos spyod g.yeng ba'i rgyu// tshe 'dir mtho 'grogs mi rjes ma snyegs bar// mthun 'jug rtsig pa sgyel zhig gzhon nu grub/ gsungs/ 'bar ra bas// mnga' thang rgyas kyin sdug bsngal che// gong ma'i sems 'dzin 'og ma'i skyongs// mnyam pa'i gnya' sdongs nor gyi gter// sdug bsngal skyel bsu sangs dus med// phun sum tshogs kyang bde skyid dka'// sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims/ gsungs/ skyes mchog bas/ lar mtho dman gcig la ma gtad na// tshe 'di blo yis mi thongs gsungs// gang byung lam du ma byas na// 'thad 'thad 'grig pas bslu'o gsungs// sgom dang rtogs pa bzang ngam ngan// rkyen dang 'phrad na gsal lo gsungs/ zhes rgya grags chos rje'i gsung bskyor ba lags par gda'/ bla ma 'ol sna bas/ gros mi gtam la nyan na sa mi zin// blo sna mang kyi mdun ma sun par slad// chos bya snyam gyi phyi gshol mthar mi phyin// tshe stod zad byung na ci tsug byed// gnas gang du 'dug kyang gsog 'jog bshol// yul gong du 'gro yang ngo shes bskyungs// mthun 'grogs bshes mang yang dbang ma gtong*// 'di bya gtong gi rang tshugs 'dzin lugs yin// su ji skad zer yang dgos med gyis// gang 'thad pa sgron la ngan med gyis// phugs ji ltar (490)song yang sdug sran bskyed// 'di bya gtong gi blo gcod byed lugs yin/

gsungs/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ tshe 'di rlung la bskur ba'i snying khams dang gcig /blo sna mi dang mi bstun pa'i long med dang gnyis/ dgos med phyi tshis bor ba'i 'phral phyid dang gsum/ 'dod yon 'khri ba chod pa'i zhen log dang bzhi/ tshe 'di blo yis gtong na dgos pa lags/ gsungs/ yang 'ba' ra bas mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i dus su dge sbyor byed/ ma 'dzom dus su ltos med mi la sprang*/ 'phral snang gang bde byed pa nam yod na// ngo bsrung mkhan la bla ma'i thugs rjes zungs/ gsungs/ ༈ bcu pa tshe 'di'i bsod nams dang 'du long spong ba ni/ khong bsod nams rgyas so zer nas 'du long mang du byung ba la yang dga' bar mi bya zhing*/ dug ltar spang dgos te/ dge bshes kha rag pas/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor yin// rnyed bkur 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin// bsod nams dge sbyor bar chad yin// dug la sman du ma ba lta ang*/ gsungs/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ sku bsod rgad po g.yo can 'dra/ rang sems byis pa mgo stong 'dra// bya bzhag rtsed mo'i dgag sgrub 'dra// mngon zhen ma chi rgya ma pa/ gsungs/ dam pa rgya gar gyi slob ma'i khyu rgyan/ dam pa kun dga' bya ba des/ pha dam pa las dngos grub rnam pa lnga blangs so// bdag yul med thab med du byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bzar med bca' med du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dris med bshes med du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mis cir yang (491)mi mthong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsod nams til gyi 'bru tsam zhig mi skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes zhum nas dka' thub byas te bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po brnyes pa zhig byung ba lags par gda'// lhag bsam bskul bar yang*// rgod dang 'gyod dang de bzhin rnam rtag pa// 'di dag thams cad 'du 'dzi rnams las 'byung*// snying po med pa'i 'du 'dzi su gyed pa// de ni lang long spyod cing ma bsdams yin// byis pa dag ni 'jig rten smra la dga'o// byis pa de dag mchog gi gtam las nyams// zhes sdang 'phel zhing rnam rtog shas kyang che// nyes pa des nad la mi chags so// gsungs/

rgyal sras pas/ na ning na snga dus su rmi lam gyi dge sbyor zin po yong gin yod pa yin te/ bar skabs su 'du long rnams kyis 'gribs song*// do zhag na ba 'dis legs par sor chud byung*/ bsod nams skyes pa skad zer ba 'di kun yang ma byung na rang yong ba 'dug gsung skad/ de bzhin du tshe blos gtong ba la khyi sngags byed pa la sogs pa'i don dang bya ba dang*/ las thams cad spangs par bya ste/ skyes mchog pas/ phan bya mang po sgrib shing yin// rang mgo 'dod na gcig la sgril// bslab shes mang po za chog yin// shes na mi byed mdo med yin/ lhag bsam bskul bar/ de yi 'dod chags shas ni che bar skye// de ni ro bro rnams la chags shing zhen// de ni ngan ngon tsam gyis dgar mi 'gyur// nyes pa 'di dag las la dga' ba yin/ gsungs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdor yang*// khyim (492)dang brten pa kun spangs te// don nyung ba dang bgyid nyung ba// bas mtha' dgon pa'i spyod yul ba// ri dwags bzhin du 'gyur bar gyis// zhes gsungs/ ༈ bcu gcig pa 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs dran par bya ba ni/ de rnams 'ong ba yang 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs shes sam mi shes la rag las te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ sems can brjed bya'i 'du shes can// brjod bya la ni gnas pa rnams// brjod bya yongs su mi shes pas// 'chi ba dang ni 'phrad par 'gyur// brjod bya yongs su shes na ni// gang gis de la gzhan dag gis// brjod bya de ni de la med// brjod pa por ni sems par med// ces pa'i mdo 'di la sa'i dngos gzhir 'grel pa mdzad do// de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dge slong dang*/ bram ze dang khyim pa rnams kyis tshig gis bsgo zhing brjod pas 'tshol dgos/ longs spyod dgos pas na 'dod yon rnams la brjod bya zhes zer ro// yang byis pa dag gis rang dgar 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs mi shes pa la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis nyes dmigs brjod par mdzad pas na yang brjod bya zher zer ro// de lta bu'i brjod bya'am 'dod pa la nyes dmigs tshad med pa yod bzhin du sems can dag gis mi shes te/

'dod pa la longs spyod pas las bsags nas skye zhing 'chi'o// mkhas pa dag gis ni 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs legs par rtogs nas nye du dang longs spyod mang nyung gang yod thams cad spangs nas rab tu byung ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i phyir brtson par byed do// gzhan dag gis skyes bu khyod kyis nye du rnams mi dga' bzhin du (493)tshe 'di'i 'dod pa rnams spangs nas tshe phyi mar 'dod pa'i don du brtson par byed dam/ zhes brjod du byung yang skyon de med la/ de lta bu'i skyon yod dam snyam du sems pa'i dgos pa'ang me dang*/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'dod pa gang yang don du mi gnyer bas so// 'dir ni ming dang gzugs la sred bcad cing*// nga rgyal spangs nas chags pa med pa de// du ba sangs shing 'joms med re ba med/ lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na de mi snang*/ zhes pa'i don ni ming dang gzugs zhes pa nye bar len pa'i byang po lnga po sdug bsngal bar mngon par mthong ba na bsams pa thag pa nas sred pa chad par 'gyur la/ de gong du 'phel ba'i dgra bcom par gyur pa na sred pa'i bag la nyal yang med par 'gyur ro// dud pa ni sred pa ste/ dug gsum gyi me'i sngon du 'gro/ shes rab kyi mig la gnod/ rtog pa ngan pas tha mal par 'dug tu mi ster bas rnam par 'khyug par byed pas so// de lta bu'i sred pa de spangs pa'am/ sangs pas 'tsho ba 'tshal ba na/ bzang po dang mang por myur bar byin na yang sbyin bdag dang rnyed pa de dag la chags pa med pas 'dod chags kyis mi 'dzams so// de de las log ste byung yang yid chad pa dang zhe sdang ba sogs med pas zhe sdang gis mi 'joms so// des rnyed pa'i nyes dmigs mthong bas dran bzhin du longs spyad pas gti mug gis mi 'joms so// sbyin pa dag 'dis rnyed pa ci 'dod pa ster ro snyam du re ba bcas shing 'gro ba med de/ de nyin mtshan dus rtag tu 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang ba ste/

myur du 'chi'o snyam nas 'chi ba'i 'du shes kyis gnas te/ de (494)lta bu'i dgra bcom pa de ni/ phyis skye ba mi len pas lha mi'i 'jig rten na mi snang ngo zhes pa'o// de ltar na 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs shes pa gal che ste// de ni mdo dang gtan bcos rnams las shin tu mang zhing*/ bdag gis legs bsdams la sogs par rgyas par bstan zin to/ ༈ bcu gnyis pa 'jig rten chos brgyad spong bar bstan pa ni/ lar na 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis ma gos pa zhig gal che ste/ 'bri khung chos rje'i

skyu ra 'jig rten mgon po/ mtshan rin chen dpal/ paṇa chen shā kya shrī'i gsung las klu sgrub kyi sprul par grags/ rje phag mo gru pa'i dngos slob/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs mtha' yas/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa'am gye re sogs grub thob mang po byon/ 'bri khung thel btab/ sde chen po bco brgyad tsam chags par gda'/ zhal nas/ ka cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba la// 'jig rten bya bzhag kyang mi bden rdzun por gda'// chos brgyad 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo la// ka blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos// gsungs/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas// 'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer// bstod dang smad dang grags ma grags/ ༈ /rnyed dang mi rnyed bde dang sdug /de rnams la ni dga' mi dga'i// rnam par rtog pa yod rigs la// chos pa yin snyam ma sems shig /sngar byas phyis byed da lta'i lam// chos brgyad kun slong yod dam med// rang gi sems la dri bar gyis// gsungs/ ༈ bcu gsum pa bde ba sgrub 'dod spong ba ni/ bshes gnyen bzang mo ba'i bzang mo ba dwags po lha rje'i dpon rgyud/ sde (495)bcu lhag gi bdag byed/ grub thob chen po'i brgyud pa sde snod mang du mkhyen/ rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs/ nā ro chos drug sbyangs pas gtum mo la rtsal thon/ phyis rgya ma 'gro mgon lob tu gnyis bsten/ sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs/ mya ngan las 'das nas kyang nam 'dod mjal/ gdul bya'i don mdzad pa sogs thams cad gzigs/ 'gro mgon la dbang dang sems bskyed zhus dus mthar nor bzang gi bla ma brgya rtsa'i mdzad pa mngon sum du bstan/ dang po dgyer chen pos 'gro mgon pa bstan/ 'gro mgon gyis khong la bstan par gsungs/ dpon slob gsum po la de lta bu'i rnam thar mtha' yas/ bzang mo bas phyis bsam yas phur bzang me dgon par 'gro mgon gyi gdan sa mdzad/ don brgyad bzhugs/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes mang du byung*/

bu chen lha dge 'dun sgang pa lha bsam khab/ lha phu dgon gsar ba/ lha bla so bab lam du gad dmar ba thams cad kyis dgon pa btab/ gzhan yang bu chen mang bar snang*/ zhal nas// 'jig rten chos brgyad bya ba 'di'o cag sems can thams cad la khyab pa yin/ de'i nang nas bde na dga' bya ba 'di khyab che ste/ sa chen po 'di'i steng na yod pa'i sems can kyam kyam byed pa 'di thams cad bde bde mo re 'dod nas 'khyams pa yin/ bde ba'i rtsa na sdug bsngal re yod pas/ bde ba la dga' bar mi bya sdug bsngal la yid shi bar mi bya/ tshe 'dir bde ba che cher byed na/ tshe phyi ma zhor la shi 'gro/ 'di 'dra zhig byas na bde ba'am skyid pa yong snyam nas chos sam 'jig rten gang rung zhig byas na bdag tshe 'di par song*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad par song ang snyam du bsam/ 'og ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du bsam (496)gsungs/ bde ba gang 'dod pa de ma byung na/ de byung na dga' ba la snyam nas 'phrad par 'dod pa'i sred pa skye/ de yang nges pa yod na ni res dga' snyam nas mngon par dga' ba'i sred pa skye/ de byung ba na 'di dang ma bral na ang snyam nas mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa ste/ da lta med kyang sngar bde skyid yod myong ba la/ de'i dus su dga' ba dang skyid pa ang snyam pa byed pa 'das pa'i 'dod pa'i ro myang ba 'das pa'i sred pa zhes pa 'byung sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa byung na 'di med na dga' ba snyam nas 'bral bar 'dod pa'i sred pa skye/ ma byung na/ de ma byung na bzang ngam snyam nas mi 'phrad bar 'dod pa'i sred pa skye/ bde sdug gang yang min pa byung na de mi nyams par 'dod pa'i sred pa byung*/ de rnams gang byung na yang sred pa dang chags pa'i dbang du song ba/ 'jig rten chos brgyad pa tsho 'di pa yin no// 'o na de rnams mi 'byung bar ji ltar byed snyam na/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ tsan+dan ste bur mtshungs pa la// chags bral zhes ni brjod pa yin/

zhes pa ltar phyogs gcig nas gcig gis gus pa chen pos tsan dan gyi byug pas byugs kyang dga' bar mi bya/ phyogs gcig nas ste 'us pa zhogs kyang mi dga' ba med par byas nas/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i 'dod mi 'dod thams cad la byung na chos brgyad 'go snyoms pa yin no// de 'dra rang re las dang po pa la bsam pa thag pa nas bcos min mi yong yang*/ blos bcos kyi na dga' mi dga'i rnam rtog spang ba la goms su bzhug pa gal che'o// chos kyi phyir du ni 'dod pa 'tshol ba dang longs spyod pa dang*/ de ma grub pa sogs byung na dga' mi (497)dga' med par nyes dmigs rig bzhin du longs spyod pa sogs dang*/ gong 'og tu bshad pa ltar nyes dmigs dus rgyun du sems/ zhen log drag po bskyed/ spong ci thub la 'bad/ ma thub pa rnams la chos kyi don du 'di mi bsten ka med byung*/ ston pas kyang gnang bas sems can gyi don du longs spyod dgos snyam pa'i dus dran dang*/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa sogs byas pas skyon med par 'gyur ro// dgyer chen po'i dgyer chen po'i mtshan gzhon nu grags/ gtso bor sne'u zur pa la bsten lung rtogs mtha' yas pa brnyes/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yi dam mang du gzigs pa sogs mtha' yas/ rin chen sgang btab/ gtsug lag khang ri rnyed bzhengs/ grwa pa brgyad brgya 'dus/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhugs/ bu chen brgyad de thugs sras 'gro mgon dang*/ sgom shes grags gnyis/ gzhan yang lto pa byang sgom/ dkri zong ba dge bshes dag /sding sa po ba/ rbas bya zug gsum/ rbas yar 'brog tu gdul bya bskyangs dgon pa btab/ bya de bya ba khri dpon tshang gi dang po'i bya ba a nag chen po de yin/ zug gis lho brag dang ror dgon pa btab/ gzhan yang bu chen mang du byon/ thams cad kyis bstan pa bskyangs so/ /zhal nas/ sngar dge bshes ston pas mdzad pa bzhin du 'o cag kyang tshigs bcad de 'don gyin ma mtha' tshig tsam gyi sgo nas kyang*/

gnyen po bsten la 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs/ gsungs/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i// rang gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru// byang chub (498)mchog gi rjes su mi mthun pa'i// shes kyis khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang*// 'khor dang rnyed bkur grags sogs bde ba'i rgyur// skad cig tsam yang smin par mi 'gyur zhing*// bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig /bde med sdug bsngal brgya yis gcos pa yis// 'khor ba'i phun tshogs yid la dran tsam gyis// lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du tshud pa ltar// yid la 'dod pa til tsam med par shog /ces bde ba la ma chags pa dang sdug bsngal dang du blangs nas chos sgrub pa zhig gis smon lam gdab dgos gsungs/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms su/ mi gang rtag tu bde ba 'dod byed pa// skye dgu dga' bar nye bar 'gro 'gyur zhing*// skye dgu sred pa rnams kyi mdun du gdar// ri bong rgya nang yongs su rgyug pa bzhin/ gsungs/ mkhas btsun pas/ phugs kyi 'dod blo zhig dang ma bral na// tshe 'di'i bya dgos chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra// gcig zin de bas mang ba slar yang skye// lus ngag bya byed nyung na mi 'thad dam/ gsungs/ sa paṇa gyis/ ha cang blo rgya ches pas 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ gcig la gcig 'phros zin med bya bas brel// 'di dang 'di dgos 'dod pas rim gyis 'brid// de 'dras mi tshe zad pa ma tshor ram/ gsungs/ skyes mchog pas/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid rlung la bskur// nyams len phyogs su sdug bsngal khur// dka' thub phyogs su lus srog btang*// gsungs/ rje rin po che tsong kha pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor ba na bde ba ye med/ da ltar bde bar rlom pa'i zas (499)zos pa'i bde ba la sogs kyang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba la bde ba'i ming btags pa tsam yin/

de ci yin na/ bkres pa'i sdug bsngal de bsten na sdug bsngal je cher 'gyur ba ltar zas kyang nan tan bskyed zos na bde ba mi yong bar sdug bsngal je cher 'gro ba de dang po nas bde ba med par sdug bsngal du yod pa'i rtags rang yin/ de yang zos tsam na bkres pa'i sdug bsngal de 'gags/ zos pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'go btsugs pa la bde bar nged rang gis rlom pa yin/ de bzhin du 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad sdug bsngal mtshan nyid pa bde ba btags pa ba yin/ de ltar yin kyang nged rang gis bde bar rlom zhing de la chags de'i ldog phyogs la zhe sdang*/ de'i mtshang 'di mi shes par gti mug gi las bsags par 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pas/ da 'khor ba'i bde ba la su zhig chags snyam du bsam gsungs/ ༈ bcu bzhi pa sdug bsngal la rgyan du blta ba la bslab pa ni/ bde ba la ma chags par ma zad sdug bsngal la rgyan du mthong nas sdug bsngal sman ltar bsten pa zhig dgos te/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'brom lo sdengs pa la snga phyogs pa dang*/ g.yu phyogs pa dang*/ stong ra ba gsum yod pa'i/ snga phyogs mang btsan zer pa la chung ma shed/ khyod lo gsum tsha ba 'thungs nas gtan du zan za ba'am/ lo gsum zan zos nas gtan du/ tsha ba 'thungs zer/ de kho shed/ ngas lo gsum tsha ba 'thungs pas/ g.yu rang yang snang (500)ba mtha' yas/ skar chen dang seng ge dpung pa sogs sgrigs pa mdung gang yong zer/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la sdug gcig dang dka' ba zhig dang du len dgos/ sdug thog nas chos shig ma byas par sems rtsa mi nom/ blo mi khengs// snam bu bkru bcag byed pa rnams so thub pa zhig bya snyam nas 'then pas so mi thub/ phar ngos ma yang 'grongs pa zhig bya snyam nas 'then na so thub/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la'ang tsham tshom med pa zhig byas na 'ong ste/ mdung khar la kha yos yong ba des dpa' bo mi 'ong*/ yos mi yong ba zhig byung na dpa' bo 'ong ba yin/

de bzhin du yos ma byung ba de ngas byas zer ba zhig dgos/ zhe phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang gi tha ma shir bcug /sang gnang na rkang mgo khyis 'drad byis pa rnams kyis mgor 'chang bstun rgyag ba zhig bya dgos snyam pa bya/ spyir 'khor ba/ khyad par ngan song*/ yang dgos mnar med du skye ma dgos na/ ltor 'khrud ma 'thung na yang 'thung*/ gos su stan gon na yang gon sems pa zhig dgos gsungs/ rje tsong kha pa'i zhal nas/ srid pa'i 'byor pas mi bslu med// gcig tu phan pa dam pa'i chos// bstan dang mjal ba lan re tsam// de phyir de yi don la dgongs/ gsungs/ dge bshes shwa bo pa'i zhal nas/ snga dro zhig mal du ma bsdad na phyi dro khram nag rer 'cha' ba 'dug/ de bas na gzhon pa kun lus sems la nus pa yod pa'i dus du gnyen po yang nus pa che ba yin pas nyon mongs pa dang 'thobs dang*// (501)rgas nas brang khog gnyer mas 'ubs ti song rtsa na/ rgas rgyu'i nyon mongs pa ma rgas par/ mi rgas rgyu'i gnyen po rgas bya bar mi 'os pa thams cad byed gzhan gyi mig rkyen ngan pa yo byed pa re yong par 'dug gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bzod pa rnam pa gsum/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa dang*/ gnod byed la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa gsum mdo bstan bcos du ma las rgyas par gsungs// bla ma gong mas bzod pa gsum sogs sdug bsngal dang len nam sdug bsngal la rgyan tu lta ba'i nyams len la gong gi gtad sa bzhi sogs phugs nor bcu'i nyams len gsungs/ chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa dang*/ ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs zhes pa don gcig /de rnams la dpyad bsgom gyis blo sbyong ba'i don no// dge bshes yon lung ba mtshams mdzad pa la/ gcig gis thu ba nas bzung nas gdams ngag tshig gcig zhu byas pas/ khyod gzhon nu la rab tu byung ba yin gyi 'chi khar mi 'gyod pa zhig gyis shig

/de la tsam pa srog thub dug po rgyab gros la bsten/ khyim mtshes kyis kyang ngo mi shes pa byas/ dma' ba'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gyon/ pha yul spangs/ bshes gnyen gyi rgya gad chu bzhin 'thungs/ tshe 'di la 'phya ba tho re ba zhig dgos/ phur shing chag mdar chu shor yang 'di la sgril nus na mi 'gyod pa zhig 'ong gsungs/ po to ba'i gsungs/ gzhan gyi bdag la snying rje'i gnas byed// bdag ni rtag tu dga' bas (502)gnas na// de la chos yod gzhan du na min/ gsungs/ yang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa mar 'gribs dus na// nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba mthu che// dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba mthu chung de phyir chos min zhugs pa rnams la// phan 'dogs mang zhing tshe ring nad med// chos las zhugs pa de las ldog pa// rang bzhin yin pas chos zhugs ma zhum// dge bshes ston pas nged la de gsungs// de lta bas na gnyen por de bsam/ gsungs/ des nas snyigs ma'i dus su sdug bsngal med pa mi srid pa lta bu yin pas/ sdug bsngal gyis ma 'jigs par bya dgos te/ sa paṇa gyis/ rtson dus bsod nams phun tshogs pa// skye bo brgya yi nang na dkon// rdzing ngan chu yis khengs pa na// phyogs gcig ci nas 'jig pa ltar// gang la nor dang ldan gyur pa// de la rigs brgyud shin tu dkon// bu dang ldan na nor ches dkon// de dang ldan na dgra bo 'ong*// thams cad phun sum tshogs gyur na// mi de myur du 'chi ba mang*/ gsungs/ dge bshes kha rag pas// rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin// bar chad dge sbyor bskul ma yin// sdug bsngal sdig pa'i phyags ma yin// sems mi dga' byur du ma blta ang*/ gsungs/ spyod 'jug las/ yid mi bde ba'i zas rnyed na// zhes sdang brtas te bdag 'joms so// ci la bab kyang bdag gis ni// dga' ba'i yid ni dkrug mi bya// gal te bcos su yod na ni// de la mi dga' ci zhig (503)yod// gal te bcos su med na ni// de la mi dgar ci byas phan// gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni// skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed// 'khor ba pa la snying rje skye// sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la dga'/

gsungs/ de ltar sems shes pa zhig byung na/ skyon yon tan du slongs/ sdug bsngal bde bar shar/ chos la bgegs dang bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa zhig yong ba yin te/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ tshogs pa rnams kyang la la khab babs kyang rta mig la phan zer/ nub mo char babs pa la dgra mi yong zer/ de bzhin du nad dang dbul phongs dang*/ gshe skur dang*/ tha na rmi lam gyi sdug bsngal tshun chad lam du slongs pas sdig pa byang ba sogs yon tan du ma yong*/ de tsa na 'phrang dang gegs byung ba legs pa yin/ de 'dra zhig gis yo kho'i chos kyi grogs su 'gro gsungs/ 'o na sdug bsngal lam du slong tshul ji ltar bya snyam na/ de la spyod 'jug dang bla ma gong ma'i lung sngar drangs pa ltar mi 'dod pa ci byung yang de la mi dga' ba byed mi rigs pa dang*/ dga' ba byed rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams bsams nas sems dga' yal le byed cing sems bskyed kyis zin pa mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam rgyud ltar sems can gyi don du bsngo ba dang gtong len byed pa sogs man ngag gi gnad yin no// de lta yin yang na ba yin na bcos su yod pa la sman bcos sogs byed par mkhas pa rnams bzhed pas de byed pa la mi rigs pa med do// byang sems 'chad kha bas/

mtshan (504) ye shes rdo rje/ rus bya/ 'khrungs yul lo ro// dang po sde snod sbyangs/ phyis sha ra ba bsten nas byang chub kyi sems 'byongs/ shar zhes spras na yod/ shar 'bum pa dar yul gyi mda' na yod/ byang sems 'chad khabs 'chad kha dgon btab/ grwa pa dgu brgya tsam 'dus/ dgung lo don lnga la mtha' phur gshegs/ yon tan mtha' yas/ bu chen se skyel bu bas spyil bu'i dgon pa btab/ gnangs pa da res kha ru'i dgon pa btab/ rnal 'byor pa byang sems yang 'chad kha ba dang*/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas dpon gnyis ka'i slob mar bshad/ khong gis gro pa dgon pa btab/ 'dul ba'i bshad nyan dar/ dgung lo don drug bzhugs/ yon tan mtha' las par snang ngo*// yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten// 'phral la gang thug sgom du sbyar// le lan thams cad gcig la bda'// kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom// sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /ces gsungs/ yang bla ma dag mi 'dod pa ci byung yang de'i rnam rtog gi rjes su mi 'brang bar lhod nas 'jog pa rkyen ngan lam du slong ba'i thabs su gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i mi la sdug bsngal dang chags sdang rang bzhin gyis 'khor/ sems klod shes pa'i mi de bde ba chen po dang mi 'bral gsungs/ de bzhin du rgyal ba yang dgon pas kyang mang du gsungs/ de ltar rkyen ngan lam du slong shes na bde skyid rgyun mi chad de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams kyi zhal nas/ skyid gdug 'di rdzun yin/ rang gi blo 'chos shes ma shes yin/ nyon mongs pa che chung 'di (505)rdzun yin/ gnyen po che chung yin gsungs/ dge bshes kha rag pas/ blo sna'i 'gro ldog ma shes na// ci byas sems la bde dus med// 'gro ldog shes pa'i mkhas pa la/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ro ang*/ gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ sdug bsngal la rgyan du mthong na/ spyod pa'i tshad yin/ gces dgu rgyab tu bskyur na grung po'i tshad yin// rkyen dang bar chad ci byung yang g.yo 'gul med na brtan pa'i tshad yin/

mos gus can gyi sgo khang na/ bla ma sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ log lta can gyis ma tshor/ dad pa can gyi sgo khang na/ dam chos sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ sdug bsngal rgyan du ma mthong bas ma tshor gsungs/ skyes mchog pas/ zhen pa gting nas ma log na/ dka' thub chu 'thungs gis mthar mi 'khyol bar gda'/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du ma shes na/ nges 'byung gi skyob mi skye bar gda'/ blo sna'i 'gro ldog ma shes na/ col chung gi rigs pa la bde dus mi 'ongs par gda'/ gsungs/ da ltar na bde sdug dngos po'i steng na med kyi blo sna sbyang lugs kyi khyad par yin par shes par byas la 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad blos gtang par bya ste/ khro los/ tshe 'di'i che thabs byas gyur kyang*// 'grub rgyu med par de bas sdug /gzabs nas bsgribs kyang 'khyogs nas 'dzol// da ni zhe 'dod thams cad thongs/ gsungs/ rje rin po ches/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin// rnyed (506)dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun// spun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos// rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas// thar 'dod khyed kyang de ltar bskyangs 'tshal lo// gsungs/ ༈ bco lnga pa bla ma la sogs pa'i phyir du yang longs spyod sgrub 'dod spang ba ni/ glang ri thang pa'i glang pa'i thang pa'i mtshan rdo rje seng ge/ rus bzhugs 'chams/ po to ba'i bu chen/ glang thang btab/ gra nyis stong 'dus/ dgung lo bdun bcu bzhugs/ yon tan mtha' yas/ sprul sa rnam snang du gsungs/ 'od dpag med kyi sprul par yang grags/ zhal nas/ lto rgyab dben par sdad pas chog gi/ tshogs sogs byed pa'i gdung ba chod/ nyin mtshan dge sor byas pas 'da' yi/ grogs po 'tshol ba'i gdung ba chod/ mi sems mal du sdad pas zin gyi/

mthun 'jug byed pa'i gdung ba chod/ bla ma sgrub pas mnyes kyi/ rnyed bkur byed pa'i gdung ba tshod/ bsrung ba 'dre la bcol pas chog gi/ drag sngags zlos pa'i gdung ba chod/ gsungs/ slob dpon rje btsun bya ba'i dge bshes bzang po zhig gis bla ma'i dus mchod bcad pas/ 'tshal pa'i dpon dga' bdes khong gi slob ma zhig la/ da lta dbus kyi dge bshes tsam la khang bzang bar 'dug pa/ bla ma'i dus mchod bcad pa rang mi 'thad dam byas pas/ khos slob dpon gyi drung du phyin te mi kun 'di skad zer byas pas/ nga (507)bla ma la mos gus med pa'am/ cha rkyen phongs pa min/ de la dmigs nas tshogs pa mang po yod bar gda' ba dang*/ dge 'dun rnams g.yeng nas dge sbyor chags pa dang*// btsun pa gnyen po chung chung rnams chud za bar 'dug pas bcag pa yin/ sdom gsum la nyes ltung gis ma gos pa zhig byed kyin yod/ 'dis thugs dgongs rdzogs mchi gsungs la/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ dus mchod rang de ngos bzang bar 'dug /shin tu ngo mtshar che gsungs/ rje re mda' ba'i zhal nas/ thos pa'i gting dpogs nas tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa snying por byed pa las lhag pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa gzhan med/ de'i thad nas deng sang gi 'chad nyan 'dra ba gzhan don ltar snang yin/ rnyed bkur lhur byed kyi thabs dbang bskur lung khrid sogs 'khor sdud pa'i thabs gzhan don ltar snang byed pa rnams snying po med gsungs/ de bas na gang la bsam kyang snying po med pas tshe thung 'di la ma chags par blos ci thongs byed pa zhig gal che// bcu drug pa tshe blos thongs pa'i dngos rgyu thun mong ma yin pa nyams su blang ba ni/ de ltar tshe blos thongs pa zhig med mi rung yin yang de'i rgyu'i gtso bo nyams su len pa med na/ tshe blos thongs pa yong thabs med pas nyams len gtso bo shes dgos/ de gang yin snyam na 'chi ba mi rtag pa legs par sems pa yin te/

rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba dran pa ma bsgom pa'i nyes (508)dmigs ni/ da gzod mthar 'che ba zhig 'ong snyam pa kun la yod kyang*/ nyi ma re re zhing de ring mi 'chi/ de ring yang mi 'chi snyam du blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa 'chi ka tshun chad la 'byung ngo*// de'i gnyen po yid la ma byas na de lta bu'i blo des bsgribs nas tshe 'dir sdod pa'i blo skyes nas 'di dang 'di dgos so zhes tshe 'di tsam gyi bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sdug bsngal sel thabs 'ba' zhig sems sems nas/ tshe phyi ma dang*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sogs don chen po la spyod pa'i blo mi skye bas chos la 'jug tu mi ster la/ brgya la thos bsams sgom pa sogs la zhugs kyang tshe 'di pa tsam gyi ched du song nas dge ba ci byas pa mthu chung zhing nyes spyod sdig ltung dang 'brel bar 'jug pas ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang ma 'dres pa dkon no// gal te 'jig rten phyi ma la dmigs nas sgrub tu chug kyang phyi nas sgrub bo snyam pa'i phyi bshol gyi le lo 'gog mi nus shing gnyid rmugs dang bre mo'i gtam dang bza' btung sogs kyi rnam g.yeng gis dus 'da' bas brtson pa chen pos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mi 'ong*/ tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mi 'ong ba de tsam du ma zad tshe 'di'i phun tshogs lhur blangs pas nyon mongs dang des drangs pa'i nyes spyod rnams je rgyas su song nas chos kyi bdud rtsi las rgyab kyis phyogs te ngan song du khrid par byed pa de las ma rungs pa ci zhig yod/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gang la 'jig rten gsum mnga' bdag /rang nyid 'chi bdag byed po med// yod des rnal zhing gnyid lag na// de las ma rungs gzhan ci yod/ ces bya ba dang (509)spyod 'jug las/ thams cad bor te cha dgos par// bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/

zhes so// 'chi ba dran pa sgom pa bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ 'chi ba dran pa sgom pa'i blo rnal ma zhig skyes na/ dper na de ring sang rang 'chi bar thag chod pa na chos kyi go ba than thun yod pa yin chad la gnyen la sogs pa dang 'grogs su med par mthong nas de la sred pa ldog cing*/ gtong ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas snying po len 'dod phal cher la ngang gis 'byung ba ltar/ rnyed bkur sogs 'jig rten gyi chos kyi phyir 'bad pa thams cad snying po med par mthong nas nyes spyod las ldog cing*/ skyabs 'gro dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i las bzang po gsog pas go 'phang dam par rang nyid 'dzegs te 'gro ba rnams kyang der khrid pas de las don che ba ci zhig yod/ de'i phyir dpe du mas kyang bsngags te mya ngan 'das chen las zhing rmo ba rnams kyi nang na ston gyi lo thog mchog go /rjes thams cad kyi nang na ba glang gi rjes mchog go /'du shes thams cad kyi nang na mi rtag pa dang 'chi ba'i 'du shes mchog yin te/ 'di dag gis ni khams gsum gyi 'dod pa dang*/ ma rig pa dang nga rgyal thams cad sel to// zhes dang*/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa thams cad cig car 'joms pa'i thob ba dang*/ dge legs thams cad cig car sgrub pa'i sgor gyur pa la sogs pas bsngags pa'o// mdor na skyes bu'i don sgrub pa'i dus ni rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus (510)'di kho na yin la/ 'o skol phal cher ngan 'gror bsdad cing bde 'gror lan re tsam 'ongs kyang mi khoms pa'i gnas su shas che bas der chos sgrub pa'i skabs ma rnyed la/ bsgrub pas chog pa'i rten re rnyed pa na yang chos tshul bzhin du mi sgrub pa ni/ da dung mi 'chi snyam pa 'di la thug 'dug pas na blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni rgud pa kun gyi sgo dang*/ 'chi ba dran pa ni phun tshogs thams cad kyi sgo'o// de'i phyir 'di la chos zab mo gzhan sgom rgyu med pa rnams kyi nyams len no snyam pa dang*/

bsgom bya yin kyang dang por cung zad sgom gyi rgyun du nyams len du mi 'os so snyam du mi bzung bar thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos lugs la nges pa snying thag pa nas bskyed de bsgom par bya'o// gsungs/ chos rje bus/ tshe 'di long med du 'chi 'gyur zhing*// gsod sar khrid pa'i dud 'gro ji bzhin du// skad cig re re zhing yang 'chi la nye// nges par 'chi ba sems dang rin chen grub// deng bya sang bya'i bsam pa ma rdzogs par// bsam pa brgya phrag ma bsam gcig 'og tshud// gshin rje 'jigs rungs nyam ngas mdun bsu nas// mal gyi tha mal dbugs sdud srog chad tshe// chos las gzhan gyis mi phan rin chen grub/ ces gsungs/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i blo shugs drag cig ma skyes nas mi mngon du grub grub mdzes mdzes lo 'dod grags 'dod cig gis khyer nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum dge ba gang byed thams cad kyang dge ba ltar snang du song nas/ tshe phyi ma la phan pa ye (511)mi yong*/ gnyid rmugs dang bre mo'i gtam dang bza' btung rnams kyang bshol thabs med pa bzhin song nas de'i dbang du 'chor/ mi rtag pa'i blo shugs drag gcig skyes na 'chi khar mi 'gyod pa'i steng du 'chi ba la dga' brod skye ba zhig yong bas 'chi ba sems pa gal che gsungs/ po to ba'i gsung las/ ston pa rnams ni ston pa'i chos shig 'dod// rgan po rnams ni rgan po'i chos shig 'dod/ mas ma ldog pa re lug mas bsgyur ba la mas ma ldogs pa zer ba ltar/ rab byung mkhan slob kyis bskyur ba la mas ma ldog ces pa'o/ rnams ni mas ma ldogs pa'i chos shig 'dod de nga la ni mi rtag pa las zla rgyu med gsungs/ mi rtag pa la byis pa bud med kyi chos tsam du mthong nas 'dug ste/ chos 'di chung bar brtsi ba la chos lar mi 'ong gsungs/ sngon gyi dus bod ston rnam snang ba sel lam mi sel/

sangs rgyas la ye shes mnga' 'am mi mnga' zhes rtsad gcod pa la/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ snang sems mi rtag pa 'di yin te/ tshe 'dis snang ba thams cad 'dis sel gsungs/ byang du nad pa zhig gi rim gror zan gyi bshos bu btang ba mi gcig gi blangs pa la 'phyas pas/ ngan na yang ngan/ byang gser kha'i bshos bu de rang rnyed par gyis dang zer/ de bzhin du mi rtag pa sgom pa la'ang ngan ngan po byed kyin 'dug ste/ 'di rgyud la skyes pa mdzod dang*/ des chog gi gsungs/ po to ba la dmigs pa sbo bar zhus tsa na/ sbo rgyu med 'di kho na bsgom/ 'di las zab pa med gsungs/ yang khyod nga bas rgyud tshod mtho na 'dir bsdad (512)pas mi phan/ nga dang mnyam na nga la snang sel chen po 'dis phan par byung bas khyed la'ang phan mche gsungs/ sngags pa zhig gi bu mo shed nga'i me long 'di chung zer/ pha shod sngon la byad blta ba 'di la gyis dang deng chung 'dug na nga'i mkhar rnga tshugs la song zer lo// de bzhin du mi rtag pa la chos chung zer ba la/ sngon la 'di rgyud la skyes pa mdzod dang*/ de nas gzhan rtsad chod gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ yang mi rtag pa ma dran pa'i chos thams cad 'khyags thog tu mkhar rtsig pa 'dra/ dal dus su stong nyid sogs yong yong 'dra 'dug kyang gal la thug dus rmang nas zhig 'gro bar snang*/ 'di skyes na sgom la ldog med// 'di ma skyes na thams cad ldog /'di skyes na byang chub kyi sems dang stong nyid la sogs pa thams cad spungs pa bzhin du yong gsungs/ sha bo pa'i zhal nas kyang nga'i 'dir mi rtag pa'i sgom nyams su 'bul kun chos kyi gting du song nas 'dug /stong pa'i sgom nyams de kha na phar yam me ba las mi 'dug gsungs/ khong gi btsun chung shed/ mi rtag pa ma go ba'i skor ba rkang pa na zer/ kho'i de bden gsung par gda'/ dgon pa ba'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa dang las 'bras 'di nyan pa pos nyan rin med/

'chad pa pos 'chad rin med/ nya ma'i chos su byed mkhas pa yang der ma red/ btsun pa dang bzang po yang der ma red gsungs/ zhang btsun yer pa'i zhal nas/ snga dro mi rtag pa ma skyes na/ nyi ma phyed na pha tshe 'di bar 'cha'/ nyin phyed lam skyes na dgongs mo 'di par 'cha'/ tshe 'di (513)par song na ci byas chos su mi 'gro gsungs/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ da nang mi rtag pa thun re ma bsgoms na de'i nyin mo tshe 'di par 'gro bar snang*/ gsungs/ ston pa rin po che la lo tig ye shes 'byung bya bas gdams ngag zhus pas/ jo bo zhig gis mi chos kyi kha bzung ba la ma mnyes pa bzhin mdzad nas/ jo bo pa chos bya ba gtug gis thugs tsa na dgos pa la/ thug dus med na dal ba'i dad pa ne tso'i kha ton yin/ tug thug dus yong ba de/ 'chi ba dang las 'bras mang du som pa zhig la yod pa yin/ de bas na/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// 'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa rigs/ bya ba yin/ go ye gsungs skad/ spyan snga bas po to ba la bskyar bas/ po to ba shed/ 'o dge bshes la gdams ngag su la yang med pa'i lkog na mo 'dra ba zhig yod pa de gsungs pa yin gsungs/ mngar sgom pa'i

'di la smyug rum pa yang zer/ mtshan brtson 'grus 'bar/ yon tan mtha' yas/ snyug rum dang dgon pa nga skya gnyis btab/ grwa pa brgyad brgya 'dus/ sku mched gsum la thug gtso bo spyan snga ba'i phu chen yin/ re brgyad la thang skyar gshegs so// zhal nas/ ngas mi rtag pa thun re sngon du ma bsgoms par chos 'chad ma myong gsungs/ khong chos de kun la man ngag tu mdzad/ 'o cag la chos de kun chang nas 'dug gsungs/ rgyal gyi skyang tsha rdol tshul gyis/ ya gi na ja chu khol gyin yod/ la 'ur tshos shig zhu zer ba la/ po (514)to ba'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa mang po sgom dang*/ tshe 'di gtong ba dang phyi ma'i don mi dka' sla ba zhig yod/ da lta khyod ja 'thung bsla/ mi 'thung ba dka'/ de bzhin du las 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang stong nyid mdor bsdus tsam re gsungs pa la/ de shwa bo sgang pas phu chung ba la bskyar bas/ phu chung ba dbu zhwa yud kyis phud nas a tsam nged kyi jo bo'i chos de kho na ang ge ces bskyar gyin gsung skad/ khams pa lung pa'i khams lung pa 'phan yul yung ba brten dge bsnyen/ dge bshes ston pa'i bu chen/ yon tan mtha' yas/ tshogs pa brgyad brgyad dus/ mtshan shā kya yon tan/ dgung lo go gcig bzhugs/ zhal nas/ mi rtag pa sgoms nas chos byed du re ba yin/ gzhan du na sems mi dga' ba las ci yong*/ mi rtag pa dran na chos min pa dgos pa med pa yong ste/ rang re gnang kho na 'chi na chu thams cad mar khur song*/ ri thams cad gser du song*/ mi thams cad nged rang gi bu dang bu mor song kyang des ci bgyid gsungs/ phu chung pa'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa dang las 'bras 'di sgoms shig /'di la nga mngon sum du mthong ba 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin gyi sgra byi so phyung*/ mi rgan po bya ba yin/ de sgom na pham pa bzhi byung yang sdig pa sbyong ba zhig yong*/ de nga'i kha chems yin gsungs/

sne'u zur pa'i sne'u 'phan yul spras/ mtshan ye shes 'bar/ byis pa'i dus na ting nge 'dzin brtan po yod/ dge bshes dgon pa ba bsten/ mkhas grub chen po mngon shes rdzu 'phrul/ yi dam gzigs shing chos gsan pa sogs mtha' (515)yas/ sne'u zur du tshogs pa stong 'dus/ lo don drug bzhugs/ dgon pa ba dang por mjal phyag dbang mdzad pas dbu thod la phyag rjes byon/ 'das dus dbu thod bu chen don steng pas bsnams nas/ ngam shod don steng dgon pa btab/ gtsug lag khang gi rten gyi gtso bor/ gdung rten chen por dbu thod yod pa de bzhugs/ sne'u zur pa'i phyag gcig gnyal gyi gser phye 'bum par bzhugs/ da lta'ang zhabs tog gdul bya mtha' yas par 'dug zer/ 'on gyi lha 'bri sgang pa don stengs pa dang mjal bas/ don stengs pas 'bri sgom pa'i rnam sbyar la sangs rgyas so lnga bzhugs pa gzigs/ der phyag 'tshal dpon slob rten 'brel 'grig /'bri sgang btab/ dar rgyas che/ dor ba rog dmar zhur ba/ po to ba'i bu chen de la yang gad pa yang zer/ skye ba bdun pa'i byang sems yon tan mtha' yas mnga'/ des be bum sngon po sdebs/ khong gi bu chen 'bri sgang pas de la 'grel pa rgyas par mdzad/ sne'u zur pa'i bu chen/ gtsang na spyi pa lhas pa dang gtsang pa rin po che gnyis/ dbus na rgyal ba'i dgyer chen po/ don stengs pas/ bsam yas na dge bshes brag thog pa sogs gzhan yang mang du byon par gda' lags so// zhal nas/ 'chi ba rjes dran rgyud la skye ba dang gcig /tshe blos thongs pa dang gnyis/ chos byed pa dang gsum 'go mnyam/ mi 'chi snyam pa dang*/ tshe 'di la shi spar 'thams pa dang*/ sdig pa byed pa gsum 'go mnyam du 'ong gsungs/ yang tshe 'di'i zhen pa las mi rtag pa sgom pas skyob/ mi khoms pa brgyad la las 'bras kyis skyob/ khams gsum thams cad las 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyis skyob/ theg dman las byams snying rjes skyob/

mtshan mar 'dzin pa (516)las stong nyid bsgoms pas skyob pa yin bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs/ sngon gyi dus su yang mi rtag pa sems pa la man ngag dam par mdzad de/ rgyal po u tra mtha' yas kyi btsun mo 'od bya ba zhag bdun nas 'chi bar nges/ der dge slong ma rim zhes pa dgra bcom ma zhig la gtad/ rab tu byung nas mi rtag pa sgom du bcug pas/ zhag bdun nas shi nas lhar skyes/ bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan pas bden pa mthong zhes 'dul ba lung las gsungs/ des na mi rtag pa sems pa 'di dngos gzhi yin/ dngos gzhi 'di min gzhan zhig yod// 'di chos kyi sngon 'gro chos la 'jug pa'i thabs tsam zhig yin snyam na ma go ba chen po yin/ 'o na byang sems dang stong nyid la sogs pa yang chos dngos rang min byas pas chog ste/ de gnyis la khyad ye mi rnyed/ 'pho ba'am 'chi ka ma'i chos zab pa yang mi rtag pa sgom pa yin par gtam rgyud des shes/ de yin pa yang rigs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam thar sgo gsum gsungs pa'i sgo smon pa med pa bya ba yang 'jig rten mtha' dag mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba bsgoms pas 'jig rten mtha' dag la smon pa med pa la zer ba lags mod/ 'dir 'dus byas thams cad skad cig gis 'jig pa dang*/ rgyun 'jig cing mi rtag pa'i tshul legs par shes nas bsgom na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa zhig thob kyang da dung thar pa'i go 'phang ma brnyes pa la/ gzod rang nyid 'jig rten pa'i lam thams cad la med pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug khong du chud de bsgoms pas/ bdud (517)rtsi'i go 'phang brnyes zer ba'i mi rtag pa sgom pa'ang 'di nyid yin pas/ bsod nams can shes rab dang ldan pas mi rtag pa bsgom pa 'di/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos rnams kyi mthil yin no snyam du shes par byas nas 'di bsgom par bya ste/

dran pa nye bar bzhag pa las/ gang 'di 'chi ba 'byung ba ni// dran pa'i mchog tu rab tu bsngags// de bsten pa ni zhi ba'i mchog /rnyogs dang bral bar 'gro ba yin// 'chi bdag 'jigs pa dran pa ni// skyon la ji ltar yid rgyug 'gyur// skyon med pas kyang dri ma rnams// thams cad rtag tu zhi bar 'gyur// bag yod go 'phang bde mchog tu// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs// gang yang 'chi bdag rtag dran dang*// mi dge rnams kyang spang bar gyis/ gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ mdo las mi rtag pa mang du bsgoms na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa byas pa yin no// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbugs phyung ba yin no// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan pa yin no// sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs/ mdo dang bstan bcos dang man ngag thams cad nas/ mi rtag pa sgom pa 'di lam gyi mchog /'jig rten gyi mngon zhen thams cad spong ba/ lhag par yang da lta'i dus/ mi rtag bsgom pa las don che ba dang khyad par 'phags pa gang na yang med do zhes lan brgyar gsungs kyang skye bo bsod nams dman pa rnams yid ma ches par gda'/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ mi rtag pa rjes dran 'di (518)zab pas rgyud la skye ba yang shin tu dka'/ ston pa dang sgom chen rnams kyang 'di la rdugs gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa bcos min zhig skyes na chos min pa ci yang yid la mi byed pa zhig yong bar 'dug ste/ 'di'i myong ba rnam dag skyes pa'i chos pa'ang re re tsam du 'dug gsungs/ phu chung ba'i zhal nas shwa bo sgang pa la dad ring yas la chas don nyar dgos/ sle mo thang du ro bsregs pa rnams ston cig gsungs/ khong gis 'di dang 'dir 'di skad bya ba bsregs pa lags zhus pas/ pad+ma byang chub jo bo kun mi ro lung skyel skyel mngon sum du byed pa 'dis mi go bar stong pa nyid la blo 'gro ba skad zer ba la yid mi ches par gda'/

nyon mongs pa rwa rong nge lde me rmig pa sha re bzhag pa'i chos byed shes pa gsungs/ shwa po pa'i zhal nas/ shes pa bas mkhas pa yang mang gsungs/ sngon gyi dus bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa na/ dge slong ma'i dge 'dun la sru skye dgu'i bdag mo dgra bcom ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni bsam gtan gtso bor bsgom la/ dgra bcom ma mchod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa ni bshad nyan gtso bor mdzad de/ spyod lam mthun pas sems bsrung ba'i phyir bsam gtan ma rnams ni mi rtag pa sgom pa las de'i tshe mi rtag dang ldan pa'i mdo kha ton byed/ mchod sbyin gyi 'khor rnams mi rtag pa sgom zhes 'dul ba lung las gsungs/ sngar 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdo'i tshigs bcad grol ba'i skabs su byung ba ltar dgra bcom pas kyang dus thams cad du 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom par gsungs/ po (519)to ba'i zhal nas/ nga'i snang sel chen mo 'di sa gnyis pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang sgom na mgu ston la sogs pa la yang gdams ngag mi chung ngam snyam gsungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ mi rtag pa sgom pa 'di gal che bas bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas kyang gsungs/ 'dul ba nas 'chag khang du keng rus bris pa tshun chad kyis dran par byed tshul gsungs te/ jo bo rje ma byin ring la man ngag tu ma shes gsungs/ yang 'di skad gsungs/ nam 'chi cha med ma bsam pas// tshe 'dir gnyen la phan gang gis dang*// dgra la gnod pa skyel ba'i phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// bshes dang dgra ru snang ba rnams// thams cad shul du bzhag nas su// ngan song mu mtha' med par 'gro// 'di las pham pa gzhan ci yod// nam 'chi cha med shi dus na// chos min gzhan gyis dgos pa med// snyam du blo sna thung sbud pa// 'bru snar shing bu gsur ba 'dra// tshe 'di'i byed byed thams cad la// zhen log blo sna skyo sing ba// ci la'ang ma chags nges par dgos/

de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa// bsgoms pas tshe 'di'i rnam rtog la// mdung zhig thebs na ci byas pa// thams cad chos su 'gro ba yin// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs las 'bras dang*/ byang chub sems dang rang bzhin med// thams cad 'di yi steng nas 'byung*// 'di bsgoms blo skyed re yang yong*/ gsungs/ rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ da mi khoms brgyad la 'jigs 'jigs (520)nas// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom// skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtad// las rgyu 'bras chos la nan tan bskyed// thabs byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ bag chags sgrib pa'i rgyun lam bcad// snang ba ci snang sgyu mar rtogs// da ngan song gsum la nyams nga med// da blo bur tshe la 'jigs 'jigs nas// lam rtsa dang rlung la rten 'brel bsgrigs// zhes jo bo a ti sha'i lam gyi rim pa dang gsungs lugs gcig kho nar gsungs/ pha dam pa'i pha dam pa yang rnam thar las sprul sku chen por bshad/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas/ sa paṇa gyis 'jam dbyangs gzigs dus kyang*/ 'jam dbyangs kyis seng ge chibs pa'i chibs kha pha dam pas bzung nas byon pa sogs gsungs/ deng ri glang 'khor gyi dgon pa btab/ bu chen dam pa kun dga' sogs ches mang bar rnam thar las gsungs/ po chung ba pa chan sgom chen/ skam shil la sogs pa rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma med par byung gsungs/ zhal nas/ 'chi ba bsam na cis kyang dgos pa med// yid la dran par gyis shig ding ri ba/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos byed lugs la kha cig bden pa bzhi nas 'jug /kha cig rten 'brel nas 'jug pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ 'chi ba sems pa nas 'jug pa 'di gnad zab/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa 'di gal che ste/ chos kyi thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du med mi rung*/ mi rtag pa skyes na dang por chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus kyi lcag byed tha mar 'od gsal chos sku (521)thob par byed do// rgod tshang pa'i

rgod tshang pa mi la'i sku skyer grags/ de yin pa rnam thar bka' rgya mar bshad/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sdug bsngal sel ba zhes par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston gsungs/ grub chen o rgyan pa/ ne dings pa yang dgon pa sogs mang ba las/ byang gling pa/ pa ri ba sogs mthar thon bcu gsum sogs slob ma 'dzam gling khyab par yod par gsungs// gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma/ yul lho brag pa/ mtshan mgon po rdo rje/ zhal nas/ pha yul 'brel thag chod pa dang*// nye 'brel 'byar rtsi gog pa dang*// zas nor 'khri ba chod pa dang gsum// 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom na 'ong*// don med bya ba mi byed cing*// nyin mtshan chos kyi las la brtson// sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba gsum// dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom na 'ong*// 'dod pa'i yon tan byung du mthong*// dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad skyur// 'jig rten chos la zhen pa log /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom na 'ong*/ gsungs/ skyes mchog pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ 'dir dgos kyi dgos ched mi bsam par// rtag tu long med 'chi ba bsam// tshe 'di dar tsam yud tsam la// sdod pa long yod mi 'dug na/ myur du 'chi ba sems pa 'di// snying gtam yin gyis sems la zhog /yeng ma lam la mi tshe zad// 'chi ba ma dran g.yeng bas khyer// nam 'chi cha med bsam blo thong*/ gsungs/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras (522)dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam la dad pa la skyed 'don dgos/ 'dod yon la skyon du mthong zhing*/ chog shes kyis blo sna bstungs la zhen log la bogs 'don dgos// bla mas ci mdzad yon tan du blta bas log rtog gi skyon snang dag cing gsol ba phur tshugs su btab la mos gus la bogs 'don dgos gsungs/ phag mo grub pas/ rtag tu 'chi bsam las su bsags pa bgrang*/ zhes dang*/ karma rol pa'i rdo rje'i

karma pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa/ brgyud pa bcu gcig yod par bzhed/ dwags po'i bu chen/ dbu se/ phag gru/ gsal stong sho re ste khams pa mi gsum gyi dbu ses/ chab chos seng ba sten sde snod la sbyangs/ dwags po bsten grub thob chen por grags/ 'bri stag gnyis/ g.yam skal ldan/ khro phu ba/ gtsang pa kun ldan/ rje spyan snga ba sogs bu chen mang*/ tshur phu btab/ 'di'i sku skye karma pak+shi khams su 'khrungs/ de'i sku skye rang byung rdo rje ga bzhur mor 'khrungs/ de'i sku skye rol pa'i rdo rje/ da nas rim bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs yin no// zhal nas/ dus 'chi bdag gi rgyal po byung tsa na/ sems bde mo zhig yong ba dka' mor gda'/ tshe phyi ma gar 'gro'i gtol med pas/ dus da lta bsam blo zhib tu thongs// lar yang bsam blo legs thongs dang*// blo yid ches bdog na ngo mtshar che/ de min na da res snying rus bskyed/ ces gsungs/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ ci byas chos su 'gro ba la// mi rtag sdug bsngal dran pa gces// rta (523)bzang lcag gis bzhus pa 'dra// chags sdang rang log ngo mtshar che/ gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'dul rgyu'i dgra med skyong rgyu'i gnyen med cing*// phar ltos dpon med tshul ltos g.yog med pa'i// dben pa'i gnas su rang sems mi 'dul na// khyed la bya ba ci 'dug ma ṇi pa// ston bsang dpyid ka spyod pa'i nges med kyang*// dpyid rgyags ston nas mi gsog blun zer na// 'chi bar nges bzhin 'chi tshe phan nges chos/ da lta nyid du mi sgrub shin tu blun// tshe 'di phun sum tshogs pa don gnyer blos// lha mi'ang thob dka' byang chub lta ci smos// de phyir tshe 'di zhen pa spang ba'i blos// 'chi ba dran pa 'bad pas bsgom par bya/ nam 'chi nges pa med pa ma dran na// thos bsam sgom la 'bad kyang tshe 'di yi// phun tshogs sgrub 'dod blo yi re brgya'i zas// ngan skyugs dug dang 'dres pa bzhin du 'gyur/

zhes dang*/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gding med kyang*// gtan du sdod grabs byed pa'i ngang ring po// 'chi khar brang lag 'thab mo 'chol nyan gda' 'o// 'chi ba rjes su dran par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsungs/ rje dwags po'i slob ma'i khyu rgyan grub thob rnal 'byor pa chos g.yung bya ba la/ khams pa zhig gis gos yug cig phul nas chos zhus pas ma gnang*/ yang nan gyis zhus pas/ kho'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ nga yang 'chi khyod kyang 'chi bya ba de lan gsum bskyar nas/ bla mas kyang de las gsungs pa med/ nga la yang nyams su len rgyu de las med/ khyod rang (524)yang de sgoms/ de las lhag pa yod re gsung nas dbu snyung bzhes/ der khams pas kyang sgoms pas grub thob cig byung skad/ spyod 'jug las/ dur khrod song nas gzhan dag gi// rus gong dag dang bdag gi lus// 'jig pa'i chos can dag tu ni// nam zhig 'go snyoms byed par 'gyur/ gsungs/ de bas na mdo bstan bcos thams cad dang*/ bod kyi chos rgyud so so ba thams cad grub mtha' gang la mi mthun yang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom dgos pa dang*/ 'di rgyud la skye ba'i smon lam dang gsal 'debs byed/ 'di bsgoms pas rgyud la skye ba'i dus shig nam yong zhes smon pa mdzad pa la mthun par snang na/ su zhig the tshom thams cad dang bral ba'i lam mchog 'chi ba rjes su dran pa sgom pa la brtson par mi byed/ de bas na 'di nyid thog mar sgom dgos pa yin te/ sngar tshe blos gtong ba chos kyi thog ma med mi rung yin par bshad pas kyang shes la/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa 'di chos kyi dbu yin/ rgya gar skad dang phyag 'tshal la sogs pa dbu min gsungs/ yang mi rtag pa dran pa/ zhang btsun yer pa dang gnyen ston shāka 'byung dang*/ 'ban gung rgyal lta bu yin gsungs/ yer pa ba dus rgyun du gshegs dgos 'ba' zhig byas/ bsnyun nang cung zad re la'ang snyad 'dogs cing*/

da cha cha gsung nas yo byad ci yod thams cad gzhan la bsngos nas/ med mi rung ci rigs la/ ma shi'i bar la g.yar chug gsungs/ gshegs pa na lha'i rol mo di ri ba thams (525)cad kyis tshor ba byung*/ rgyags lhag nas khal drug min pa ci yang mi 'dug pa la/ phu chung ba ni dkon mchog mchod pa bya gsungs/ po to ba dge 'dun gyi chos ston bya gsung skad/ gnyan ston ni dang po mkhas pa'i nga rgyal che/ dpe mkhyud kyang che ba la phyis gcung po zhig shi bas rkyen byas tshe blos gtang gi bya ba mdzad/ yid 'byung nas mi rtag pa kho na sgom/ skyo sangs mdzad dus kyang mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas// 'chi ba so sor bral gyur zhing*// mya ngan chen po ldang gyur pa// de ni 'jig rten 'di na nges/ zhes sogs kho na gsungs/ khro phu'i ston pa gzhon nu tshul shed/ gnyen ston ston pa chen po zhig mi rtag pa sgom zer ba cang bden nam zhes 'phya ba la/ rnal 'byor pa chen po'i zhal nas/ yod na kho'i de la gcig yod gsungs/ gnyen ston la nye gnas kyis dbyar shing grabs byed par zhus pas/ dbyar sdod mi sdod cha med/ shing bu'i grabs kyis ci byed/ sdod na tshur ston cig yang gsungs nas bzhugs rtsis ye mi mdzad/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ gnyan ston ni bden pa gzigs pa'i tshod tsam du 'dug na gsungs/ po to ba rang la yang mi rtag pa 'khrungs pas rnyed bkur sogs ji ltar mang ba zhal ras nag tu 'gro ba zhig yod skad/ chig lab ring mo na mar yang*/ da la ni do nub shi na ji tsug byed snyam nas sang phan chad kyi mdun ma mi dran pa yang yang byung gsungs/ lan cig ston pa rdo rjes phul ba'i rgyas pas dbu mdzad chos po ti brgya bdun bcu tsam gyi na bza' grub pa nas/ yang (526)'be ston gyis phul ba'i na bza' gyis gsungs/ der dge bshes brag dkar bas/ dar dang phying pa la sogs pas kyang mi ldang*/ khad kyis bya bar zhu zhus pas/

nga la long med gcig gis ldang na gcig gyis/ gnyis kyis ldang na gnyis gyis gsungs/ de nas po tor po ti sum brgya tsam gyi na bza' byas/ de nas zhag gsum song ba na snyung nas zhag bdun na gshegs/ kho rang 'da' ba'i mngon mkhyen yod par 'dug gsungs/ rtag tu gnas nges med mdzad cing 'byon pa la/ grwa pa nyis stong lhag tsam 'du/ tshe blos thongs pa/ mi rtag pa dran ngo shes pa lnga brgya tsam yod pa la/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngo mtshar che/ da ni re re tsam yang rnyed par dka' gsungs/ yang mi rtag pa dran pa kha rag

'phan yul spras kyi zag rgyab na yod/ sgom chung lta bu yin gsungs/ khang kha rag phug nag gi brag khung na bzhugs pa'i sgo na se phung zhig yod pa la/ na bza' ral bas gcod dgos dgongs pa re byung*/ yang de ma thag bcad nas ci byed 'gro 'ong byed kyin sdod rgyu rang yod de dgongs nas phyis gshegs gshegs bar du gcod pa ma byung skad/ gzhan yang dge bshes gsang phu ba dang*/ rngog legs she mi shi ba gsan tsa na jo bor bya gtong gda' ang gsungs/ gsang phu'i shing nags bsrung bar zhus pa/ bu nang gi bdag tu 'dzin pa mi spong na'ang*/ phyi rol gyi dngos po bdag tu bzung ngam gsungs/ bshes ston g.yung drung rgya mtsho bshen ston mi shi ba gsan dus ye chos zab mo gda'o gsungs dmar khrid zab shos rang de shi ba mthong ba dang thos (527)pa kun yin gsungs/ gshen ston la mis lkog smras byas pas/ nga ni 'di na 'dug go gsungs lo// de lta bu 'chi ba dran pas 'byung ba yin gsungs/ la sogs 'di gnyis ka jo bo'i slob ma/ rngog legs shes gsang phu btab/ mkhas grub chen po zhig byon/ gshen ston gyis bsam yas su gdul bya bskyangs/ bu chen mang ngo*/ pa'i gtam rgyud gsungs/ 'o na mi rtag pa sgom pa de ltar gal che phan yon che na/ 'o na don tshan rnam pa du ma zhig byas byas nas sgom snyam na/ spyir bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams don tshan zhib tu so sor 'byed pa'i sa bcad mi mdzad/ 'on kyang sngon mkhas pa re re gnyis gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas byed pa'ang mang du yod/ bsam rgyu'am sgom rgyu'i don la ni thams cad khyad mi gda'/ sngon gyi gro lung pa chen po'i lam rim na yod tshod du 'dug /da lta rje rin po che yab sras ni/ rtsa ba gsum/ rgyu mtshan dgu zhes pa'i sa bcad mdzad do// da ltar grags che/ sngon gyi phyag sor pa phyag tshor pas nag tsho lo tsā ba sogs jo bo'i dngos slob dang nying slob du ma la thug

/grub pa brnyes/ bya 'dul 'dzin sogs bu chen mang du byon/ nas brgyud pa'i mkhas pa dag ni/ mi rtag pa sems pa la gsum/ rags pa'i mi rtag pa dang*/ phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang*/ glo bur gyi mi rtag pa'o// dang po la spyir 'dus byas yin pas 'jig par nges par dang*/ rang dbang med pas 'chi ba bsam pa gnyis/ phra ba'i mi rtag pa skad cig re re bzhin mi rtag par 'gro ba'i gzar las chu 'gro ba dang*/ phyugs rdzis phyugs 'ded pa la (528)sogs pa'i dpes sems/ glo bur gyi mi rtag pa la bzhi/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa dang*/ lha 'khrugs pa dang*/ gnyis ka 'khrugs pa dang*/ zas gos gnas mal la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis blo bur 'ching sems pa ste/ de ltar mdzad do// bshes gnyen gzhan dag mang po ni/ phyi mi rtag pa dang nang mi rtag pa gnyis/ dang po la snod mi rtag pa dang*/ bcud mi rtag pa'o// nang mi rtag pa la gsum/ skad cig re re zhing 'jig pa dang*/ rgyun gyi mi rtag pa tshe tshad yod cing*/ de'ang mda' 'phangs pa'am chu klung drag po 'bab pa las kyang mgyogs par 'gro ba dang*/ glo bur gyi mi rtag pa la tshe zad pa dang*/ las zad pa dang bsod nams zad pa dang*/ bag med pas glo bur du 'chi ba ste bzhi'o// bdag gi bla ma'i bdag gi bla ma rje mkhas grub pa'i mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po/ la stod byang gi sde bdag /bka' rab 'byams thugs su chud// rje tsong kha pa'i rgyal tshab 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/ ri bo mdangs can gyi dgon pa btab/ nyang stod lcang ra dpal 'khor chos sde dge ldan rnams kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bu slob mang du byon/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun la dge ldan du gshegs/ zhal nas/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i dmigs rnam skyong ba la/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ dmigs pa skyong rgyu rnams kyi ngo bo// go rim grangs nges rnams nges nges byas/ 'di las gzhan du mi btang snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya/

dang po nas blo ngan langs la mi gtong bar 'dug pa ji ltar btang ba bzhin du skyong dgos gsungs pas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa la sgom rgyu'i dmigs pa'i grangs dang*/ go rim (529)rnams gal che bar mthong nas de ltar bris pa lags/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ 'di'i yig cha na ji ltar yod pa bzhin go rim ma 'chol bar sems pa dang*/ gang zin zin nas sems pa gnyis yod gsungs pa ltar/ dang po ma 'dris ring la go rim ma 'chol bar bsgoms/ 'dris pa na gang 'dod pa nas sems pas go rim nges pa med/ dmigs pa'i grangs mang nyung la ni khyad cher byed dgos/ de yang don tshan mang po nas bsams na stobs che bar 'phags pa thogs med kyis nyan sar gsungs pa bzhin/ rje rin po ches kyang gsungs/ de nged rang gis kyang shes/ gnyen gyis gnod pa byed pa yi// rgyu mtshan mang du mthong gyur na// gnyen la chags pa spong ba sla// dgra yis phan pa byed pa yi// rgyu mtshan mang du mthong gyur na// dgra la zhe sdang zhi 'gyur te// byams pa myur du skye ba bzhin// dgra yi gnod pa byas pa yi// rgyu mtshan mang du mthong gyur na// zhe sdang shugs drag skye ba'ang ltos/ 'o na sgom rgyu'i dmigs pa de rnams yin mod/ de rnams tshul lam rnam pa ji ltar sgom snyam na/ de ni shes rab can gyis dmigs yul de rnams ma 'dres par so sor phye zhing blo la gsal btab ste 'dris su bcug /goms su bcug na blos gsal bar nges/ gsal bar dmigs/ gsal bar mthong ba zhig yongs su 'jug pa yin no// de ltar blo la gsal btab pa de nyid nyams pa med brjed pa med par de ka'i ngang la gnas na/ slar bskyar gyin sgom mi dgos par de ka'i ngang la hril gcig tu 'gro ste/ dper na mi dag gis rgya nag gi rgyal (530)po'i bkod pa bshad na de ma brjed par yid la byas na/ slar bskyar gyin 'chad mi dgos par dus nam yang blo la bkra lam me yong ba bzhin no// brjed na yang gsal btab kyin 'jog dgos pa yang dpe don gnyis ka 'dra'o// ston pa se ston bka' gdams kyi bshes gnyen/

gyi zhal nas/ bka' brgyud 'di'i lugs kyi mkhas pa dang gtso bo dang chos 'chad pa la sogs pa yon tan gzhan thams cad bzhag nas sems pa kho na 'go 'don pa yin gsungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ jo bo rje de rtse gcig pa las kyang so sor rtog pa la bsngags gsungs/ spyan snga rin po che de lan gcig dge bshes yon lung pa'i phyag nas bzung nas nga 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung ba'i nad pas kyang*/ mi ma yin gyis 'chi ba zhig la 'dam pa yin/ ci sten 'byung ba'i nad la sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i bzod pa yod kyang*/ gzhan gnod pa byed pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa med/ mi ma yin gyi de la de gnyis ka yod/ de bas kyang rang gi nyes pa sna gcig ma byas par gcig gcig gis gri zhig rgyab 'chi yang ma nyen drag kyang ma nyan pa sdug bsngal yang de la bka' drin che ba'i blo bsha' ma zhig byung na chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa dang gsum kar tshang ba de la go yul tsam gyis mi yong ste/ yang dang yang du sems pa dang*// 'jal dang nges rtogs sgom pa'i lam/ bya ba yin gsungs/ rin po che sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ nga 'chi na/ nga 'chi na snyam du bsams pas mi yong bas/ bla ma'i man ngag la bsten nas bgrang ba dang gzhal ba'i rnam pas sgom pa yin gsungs/ khong gi gsung 'di kun gzhan la med pa'i chos skad (531)bla ma mkhas grub dam pas zin pa'i zhad cig rang gda'/ 'di 'dra go ba'i mi rang srid mtha' tsam du gda'/ yang sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ da lta tshig tsam gyi sgo nas mos pa byas pas/ skye ba phyi ma la mi rtag pa mngon sum du mthong ba 'dra ba yong*/ a ti sha'i chos 'di lta bu sngar yang ma byung*/ da yang yong ste mi yong gsungs/ ༈ cu bdun pa nyams len rgyud mi chad par bya ba ni/ rin po che shwa ra pa'i zhal nas/ ngan song gsum gyi nyes dmigs kun mang du bsams kyang rtag tu ma bsam na 'od long thos pas bskul ba bzhin du 'jug pa yin// las dang po pa la dang po yid ches pa yod kyang bag tsam yengs pas lhod lhod 'cha' ba yin/

ban+de gzhon pa kun gnyer lo re ba btsan chos dang gnyen po dung phyis pa bzhin 'gro gsungs/ rin po che po to ba'i gsung las/ de bas na dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs kyi/ tshig 'di'i yan lag re re'ang*/ sna tshogs tshul gyis nan tan du sems/ lan gcig lan gnyis sogs kyis ma yin/ don 'di rang la ma skyes bar du bsams na/ chos gzhan kun kyang gdod 'ong*/ de yang grogs dang bshes gnyen gnas gsum/ mthun pa'i rkyen dang ldan pas bsams na/ yin gyi gzhan du na ni ma yin/ gsungs/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ mdze can rkang pa dang lag pa chad pa la/ sman thun re re gnyis gnyis bsten pas cir yang mi 'gyur ba ltar/ 'o skol thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa'i nad gzhi tsha ba can gyis thebs pa las gdams ngag gi don lan re re gnyis gnyis tsam gyis nyams su blangs pas (532)mi chog pas/ lam gyi cha thams cad rdzogs par so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad cing chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'bad 'tshal te/ bshags bstod las/ der yang rgyun du sems ni rmongs pa la// yun ring dus su nad gzhi bsten byed cing*// mdze can rkang pa lag pa chad pa la// thang 'ga' sman bsten pa yis ci bgyir mchi/ zhes dang*/ yang tsan+da go mīs/ sems kyi shing ni thog ma med dus can// nyon mongs kha ma'i khu bas brlan dgos pa// ro zhim dngos por bgyi bar mi nus ltar// yon tan chu yi thigs pas ci ru 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar 'di rnams dus rgyun pa'i nyams len du byas na blo goms pa'i rjes su byed pas/ dang po blo sbyong ba dka' seb yang*/ phyis de la ngang gis 'jug pa zhig 'ong gsungs/ da lta ci rigs mi rtag pa sogs sgom du bcug na/ na ning ma bsgom par yang nga 'chi snyam pa skyo dung dung yong gin yod pa yin te/ da ni ci bsgoms kyang shes pa thom yur song nas mi yong bar snang zer nas bshol btong ste/ bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ltar sgom ma thag nas skyo dung dung rgyud ma chad par yong*/

de yong na/ stong nyid la sogs pa'ang sgom ma thag nas skye bas lam thams cad zhag kha yar la rdzogs yong ste/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ blo ngan goms kyi bag chags shog dril 'dra// nyams gsar bu skyes kyang rkyen gyis 'jig /dus yun thung gis 'khrul pa mi chod kyi// sgom yun du srings shig sgom chen kun/ gsungs/ yang*/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma zhang gis de ma thag tu drod rtags 'dod/ bshol la khad kyi (533)snga ltas yin/ snyugs srings dgos na ci tshug mchi/ bya ba dang*/ snyugs srings 'dod chags ma nye mdzod// la 'ur phye gtor ma 'gam mdzod/ gsungs pa 'di gnad che/ 'di nga la nan star byung ba zhig byung*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas gom gom pa zhig spang*/ ma goms pa zhig skyed dgos pa yin pas sgom yun sring dgos gsungs/ ༈ bco brgyad pa nyams len rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu tshogs bsten pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rnams kyi zhal nas/ de ltar bsgom pa na mi rtag pa la mtshon na yang de la blo 'gro tshad kyis sems/ blo mi 'gron dkon mchog la mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams la yan lag bdun pa bya/ yang sems/ yang ma byung na/ btsan phur mi bya bar/ las 'bras sogs sems/ de ma 'don na sdig pa sbyong*/ de ma byung na yang*/ gang 'dod pa dang yong ba zhig sems pa la sogs pa gang yong nas byed/ yong ba 'dug nas gzhan rnams bzhag nas/ de nyid la chig sgril byed de/ mi rtag pa lta bu la blo sbyong na/ bla ma dang grogs po mi rtag pa la thugs dam mdzad pa zhig bsten/ chos lta rtog byed pa yang mi rtag pa'i skor na yang 'dug pa rnams blta/ tshogs bsog sgrib sbyong thams cad kyang mi rtag pa'i blo skye ba'i ched du byed/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ thog mar zhing gi mthu la bsten nas ni// nang gi bsam pa'i stobs ni skye 'gyur bas// dge ba'i bshes dang dkon mchog mchod pa'i las// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sbyor ba bsten 'tshal lo// zhes pa ltar/

lha dang bla ma dang chos skyong rnams la mchod pa dang gtor ma phul nas de skye bar gsol ba 'debs/ de rnams sgom pa'i phan yon dang*/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs rnams legs par bsam gyin dus rtag tu 'di la blo sbyong ba'i 'dun pa drag (534)pa bya/ thun gyi dngos gzhir ma zad thun mtshams thams cad du yang nam 'chi cha med pa dang*/ cis kyang dgos pa med pa'i don rtsa gnyis po de la dran shes yang yang bsten/ de'i tshig gang rno rno gsal ba rnams bton gyin dran pa gso// de kham gtogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya ba lta ci smos/ chos phyogs kyi bya ba gzhan rnams kyang ci nyung du bya/ bgegs dang bar chad mi 'dod pa gang byung yang rang gang sgom pa de nyid kyis ci sel bya/ lar nas 'gal rkyen du gang 'gro ba rnams spangs/ mthun rkyen med thabs med pa rnams tshogs par byas nas/ da ni de nyid min pa bya rgyu med snyam pa zhig bya/ gzhan yang chos 'di sgom du 'jug /de'i bsngags pa brjod/ de'i mthun rkyen sbyor ba sogs ci 'grub byed/ chos 'di rnams tshang na ni tshe 'dir nges par skye/ gal te ma skyes na'ang tshe phyi ma la tshegs med par skye ba zhig 'ong gsungs/ sngon gyi dus mi zhig gis bud med kyi ro lto bral ba zhig mthong nas de ci 'dra bar bud med thams cad de 'dra la rang gi lus kyang de 'dra'o// snyam yang yang yid la byas pas/ de shi nas rgya gar du rnam thos sras kyi dpal la 'gran du rung ba'i gtso bo chen po zhig gi sras su skyes// rigs kyi bu grags pa zhes par gyur te cher lon pa na btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor te 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par rtse zhing gnyid log pa na/ bud med gnyid log pa rnams mthong ba na/ dur khrod shed na 'dug pa snyam du mi gtsang ba dang skyug bro ba dang*/ yid 'byung ba dang*/ 'jigs pa'i 'du shes skyes te de nyid du langs nas nam la bros phyin pas bcom ldan 'das dang mjal/

chos nyan pas bden pa mthong dgra (535)bcom pa chen po grags pa bya ba byung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por 'jig rten du chos gsungs dus lnga sde dang grags pa la sogs pa'i nye ba'i lnga sde byung bya ba'i grags pa de 'di yin/ dgra bcom pa thob skad de dang 'dra bar da lta mi rtag pa'i blo nan gyis sbyangs na yon tan gzhan gang yang ma skyes kyang da gzod gang du skyes pa der/ mi rtag pa dran nas ci la'ang mi chags par chos min pa'i dgos pa med pas sangs rgyas kyi sar thog pa med par 'gro ba zhig 'ong bas mi rtag pa sgom pa la 'bad 'tshal lo/ ༈ bcu dgu pa lam gong ma la slob cing*/ rang gi bla ma'i man ngag la yid ches bya ba ni/ de'i steng du gzhan bsnan gyin sgom pa byung na ni de bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags ste/ ༈ ldi ri drag po bya ba spun gnyis kyis dge bshes ston pa la grub mtha' nyan 'ong pas/ ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ rgya gar na nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i 'jug pa gcig bya ba dang*/ phyi rol pa'i 'jug pa rnams pa bdun bya ba yod zer/ rang cag bla ma'i man ngag bsgom/ man ngag gang yin na/ 'chi ba dang las 'bras mang du bsgoms nas tshul khrims dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan par bsgoms nas des 'phangs pa'i sgo du ma nas tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong ba man ngag yin gsungs/ yang ston pa 'od zer rgya mtsho zhig gis zhes zhus pa la yang de skad gsungs/ khams pa dpal 'bar gyis 'gro chos zhus pas kyang*/ ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad ting nge 'dzin du 'gro ba zhig yod de/ de gzhon dus lus sems la sbyangs pa byas pa zhig la (536)yong ba yin/ rang cag bla ma'i man ngag sgom/ man ngag gang yin na 'chi ba dang las 'bras mang du bsgoms nas tshul khrims dag par bya/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan par bsgom/ des 'phangs pa'i tshogs sna tshogs nas bsog
