/sdig sna tshogs nas sbyong ba de man ngag yin gsungs/ pu to ba'i gsung las/ ston pa'i yon tan ji bzhin bsams pas/ skyabs su btang ste sangs rgyas par gzhug /de nas dal 'byor rnyed dkas sna drangs// 'chi ba rjes su dran pa la sbyar// de nas rtag tu bden bzhi bsal bas// 'khor ba mtha' dag nyes pa shes bya// bdag ci 'dra bar de 'drar shes pas// kun la byams dang snying rjes 'jug bya// des bskyed byang chub sems dang ldan no// chos rnams thams cad de la kun gnas// kha chems rlung la bskur na de yin/ gsungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ 'o cag rab tu byung ba rnams// nyams su blang bya dkar po'i chos// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde nas// 'di las med do skyes bu kun// mi rtag pa nas gnas lugs bar// lam rim 'di la blo sna sbyang*/ gsungs/ rin po che sne'u zur pa'i zhal nas/ rong du sngags pa tshan gcig chang phud gtor ba la khrel bas/ sngags pa lha me 'bar bya bas chang phud gtor nas// dkon mchog gsum po bzhes/ chos skyong srung ma bzhes/ dus gsum pha ma bzhes/ 'gro drug sems can bzhes/ rang lus rgyu cang gda'i zer/ de bzhin du dpal ldan a ti sha'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di la rgyud sde bzhi dang (537)sde snod gsum gyi don gang yang ma 'dus pa med/ de ltar na jo bo'i sman 'di sbyar legs pa lags pas/ 'di la bag re gsol bar zhu/ gsol gyi rting la mi skyug par zhu/ skyug skyug 'dra na mchil ma dang phu yis gdab/ rdo grang rlan skra then pa tshun chod byed par zhu/ de nas da lta kha na mi gsol na yang*/ phyis gsol ba'i ched du a 'phrag g.yon kho nar gzhug par zhu/ brul dogs na phugs su yang 'phul bar zhu/ gsungs/ shwa bo ba'i zhal nas/ skyes bu rab 'bring gsum la blo sbyong ba 'di sdom pa 'bogs bdo ba yang yin/ slob gnyer byed bdo ba yang yin/ 'dir blo 'byongs na/

nor 'tshol ba'i blo mi skye bas mi thams cad dang yod pas tshogs gsog byed bdo ba yang yin/ 'thun 'jug byed bdo ba yang yin/ gsungs/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor don che shin tu rnyed dka' dang*// de yang chu bur bzhin du myur 'jig cing*// de nas gang yang rjes su mi 'brang la// dkar nag las 'bras phra'u'ang mi bslu ba'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung chos 'di ring du soms// de ltar dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' gnyis mi rtag pa las 'bras te/ chos bzhi'i rtsa ba brtan gyur na// dge chos lhag ma bde blag nyid du skye/ zhes dang*/ de yis phan bde'i rtsa ba ma bzung pa'i// mkhas par rloms dang bsam gtan bla ma sems pa can/ gser gling phyin pa'i tshong pa stong log 'dra/ zhes dang*/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba// klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ (538)legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa ni// skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na// gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste// gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir// dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin// bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang*// gsung rabs ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang*// nyes skyon chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrungs/ de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni// skal ldan du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis// yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod// gsung rab kun gyi snying po bsdu bsdu ba// tshul 'di thun re ston dang nyan pas kyang*// dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon tshogs// rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsam/ zhes dang*/ de ltar rtsa ba brtan la gtsor 'bad nas// rgyal bas dam chos gsungs pa thams cad las// kha cig da lta lag tu blangs pa dang*// gzhan dag smon lam yul du byas gyur te// gcig kyang mi spong kun kyang sangs rgyas thabs// de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs pa// lam du bsrel ba shes na mkhas pa'i phul/

zhes gsungs/ de ltar na snying nas chos don du gnyer ba yod na/ dang por tshe 'di'i bya ba dkar nag khra gsum 'dis blos gtong ba rang gal che/ de yang mi thabs sdug shos rang yin nam gtogs bya ba nag po srog gcod pa dang rku ba la sogs pa rnams bya ba ma rigs pa yin pa go yang sla/ spang thub pa yang (539)re mang yong bar snang ste/ bya ba dkar po'am khro bo'i rigs dbang bskur chos bshad lha bzhengs dang sbyin gtong*/ grong chog dang sāts+tsha/ bsrung ba 'bri ba'am 'dre 'dul sngags 'debs sam/ nyan klog la sogs pa tshe 'di'i zhen pa re ma spangs pa'i tsab tsub 'di rnams spong nus pa rang nyung bar snang*/ sems tshe 'di'i zhen pa dang ma bral ba'i bya ba ci legs kyang dgos pa rang med mi gsung ngam/ lar na dge mi dge thams cad sems kyi byed las yin pas sems 'di lha 'dre mi gsum gyis zhe ma khrel ba zhig dgos pa lags mod/ ye shes grub pa

rgyal po in dra bo dhis mdzad do// las kyang*/ las gang bya ba ci yang rung*// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis byed// bzhi pa gzhan na yod yin pas// de rnams 'di ltar dpyad par bya// sems med par ni lus ngag gis// ci yang byed par nus ma yin// de med par ni tshig gis kyang*// nam yang nus 'gyur ma yin no// de bas lus ngag las rnams ni// yid nyid las ni 'gyur ba yin// 'gro ba thams cad sems kyis ni// dge dang mi dge gang byed pa// phan don 'gyur ba'i las rnams ni// thams cad legs par dpyad par 'gyur// logs pas bsod nams ma yin zhes// rgyal ba'i mchog rnams rab tu gsungs// des na dge dang mi dge kun// sems nyid kyis ni byed pa dang*// sems nyid kyi ni 'jig 'gyur zhes// 'gro ba'i bla mas gsungs pa yin/ ces gsungs/ 'od srung gi le'ur yang*/ dper na mi zhig rgya mtsho'i chus khyer la// de ni skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byed 'gyur// de (540)bzhin chos mang sred pas bag med pa// chos kyi rgya mtshor gnas kyang ngan 'gror 'gro// dper na sman pas sman sgror bcug pa'i sman// 'jig rten kun tu yongs su rgyu byed kyang*// nad kyis btab pa zlog par mi nus na// de yi sman de don med 'gyur ba yin// de bzhin dge slong tshul khrims yon tan ldan// thos dang ldan yang tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i// nyon mongs 'byung ba'i nad ni mi sel na// de yis thos la brtson pa don med yin// gsungs/ mdo 'di kun la bsam blo re thong dang ji skad gsungs// mi tshe hril gyis chos kyi lag len byas/ mi rnams snyam pa chos pa zhig yin no snyam/ khong rang snyam pa'ang chos pa zhig yin no snyam/ chos kyi rgya mtshor gnas nas skom drir shi nas ngan 'gror 'gro dgos pa yang gsungs pa de su la gsung pa yin par 'dug /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal re ma thag /bde ba re ma spongs/

bde bde mo// skyid skyid mo// snyan snyan mo re sgrub sgrub nas/ dbang bskur chos bshad nas nyin klog 'don pa yan chad byas kyang thams cad tshe 'di'i so nam du song bas len pa lags mod/ 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal myong tshad 'di 'jig rten chos brgyad 'dis lan 'jug pa la/ da dung yang bya ba dkar nag khra gsum gyi 'jig rten chos brgyad je rgyas dang je cher gtong ba 'di byas pa thams cad don med yin// nad la mi phan pa'i sman rkyal khur gyin rgyug pa dang 'dra gsung bar gda' ba// des na tshe 'di'i bde skyid thams cad la bsam blo ye mi gtong bar blos lings kyis gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan da mi go bar 'dug gam/ 'o na 'jig rten chos brgyad dam/ nyon mongs kyis kun nas slong tshad ngan song gi rgyu (541)sdig par 'gro ba yin nam snyam na/ spyir 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis kun nas slong nas byas pa'i bya ba dkar nag khra gsum thams cad phyis nges 'byung khyad par can gyis zin na ma gtogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu kho na yin pas nyon mongs pas kun nas slong pa'i chos byas pa thams cad don med yin gsung pa de yin/ ngan song gi rgyu'am sdig pa yin min ni gnyis su 'ong ste/ skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi chung ngu'i dge ba bsags pa thams cad 'khor ba'i bde ba kho na thob 'dod kyis byas pa yin pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dang nyon mongs kyis byas shing bsags/ de'i nang nas kyang 'dod chags kyis dge ba bsags pa yin pas/ de rnams dge ba yin kyang sdig pa ni min/ de yang skyes bu chung ngu 'dod khams kyi lha mi'i phun tshogs thob par 'dod pa rnams ni sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i bsod nams bsog /gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams kyi phun tshogs thob par 'dod pa rnams ni/ zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong dang*/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom par byed pa la sogs te/

de rnams nyon mongs pa dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis byas pa yin yang sdig pa ma yin dge ba yin/ dge ba de rnams la bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba zhes gzhung chen mo rnams las gsungs/ de bzhin du khams gong mar gtog pa'i nyon mongs thams cad dang des bsags pa'i las thams cad mi dge ba ma yin/ de bzhin du 'jigs skyobs dang legs smon gyi tshul khrims dang legs smon gyi sbyin pa la sogs kyang mi dge ba yin pas 'jig rten chos brgyad dang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas byas (542)shing bsag pa yin yang*/ sdig pa dang mi dge ba min pa ni mang du yong ba lags/ khams gong ma'i nyon mongs g.yo sgyu la sogs pa thams cad zhi gnas kyi nye bar brten pa dang dge ba'i chos mang pos yongs su zin pas mi dge bar mi 'gro ba yin ces 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs so// 'o na dge ba gang yin/ mi dge ba gang yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis rab tu smad cing nam yang mi bstod pa'i las rnams dang de kun nas slong ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams la mi dge ba/ de'i 'gal zlar gyur tshad kyi las dang des kun nas slong ba rnams dge ba/ de gnyis gang yang min pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las la lung ma bstan zer ba lags/ de ltar na nyon mongs kyis kun nas slongs pa la'ang sdig pa min pa mang du yongs yod/ tshe 'di'i rnyed bskur ram snyan grags sems/ bde skyid kyi phyir dbang bskur chos bshad mdo 'don sngags zlos sogs byed pa ni sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i phung por yod ste/ zab mo'i chos btsongs pa dang*/ brnab sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ g.yo sgyu dang*/ tshul 'chos dang*/ kha bsags dang*/ gzhogs slong dang*/ thob 'jal dang*/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang*/ ngag 'khyal la sogs pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad char chen po bzhin rgyun mi 'chad par 'ong bas de la dgongs nas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang*/

tshe 'di zhen pa dang ma bral na ci byas pa thams cad sdig pa yin ces mang du gsungs/ yang tshe 'di la zhen pas byas pa thams cad don med pa'i sdig (543)pa yin pas de la dgongs nas kyang thams cad sdig pa yin par gsungs pa yin ang snyam/ tshe blos gtong gi nyams len gyi gnad 'gags mdor bsdus na/ 'khor bas bsdus pa'i tshe 'di'i bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rnams la/ rang 'khris med pa'i gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang*/ byang chub sgrub pa la med mi rung yin nam ma gtogs blang dor gyi blo drag tu 'byung ba rnams/ nyon mongs pa dang chags pa dang*/ sred pa dang*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dang tshe 'di'i zhen 'khris kyi dbang du shor ba yin pas/ gnyen pos btsan thabs su rgyun bcad/ med mi rung gi zas gos sogs la bcom ldan 'das kyis sred pa'i dbang du mi 'chor ba dang*/ bsod nams khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i phyir dmigs rnam mang po zhig gsungs pa de'i rigs pa gzhan la'ang shes par byas la sred pa'i dbang du mi btang*/ spyir bya ba thams cad la nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byed pa ni chags sdang gi dbang du mi 'chor ba'i thabs kyi rgyal po yin pas de dran par byas la/ bde sdug gang la'ang blang dor med par bya zhing nges par dgos pa rnams la de gnyis kyis zin par byas na khams gsum thams cad la blang dor gyi chags pa dang bral ba'i dgra bcom pa'am sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob yong ba lags so// legs bshad 'di sbyar dge ba gang*// thob pa de ni 'gro ba kun// khams gsum kun la chags bral nas// thams cad mkhyen pa myur thob shog// rgyal ba kun la mchod (544)dang bsti stang byed// 'dod pas byang sems rnams la mchod par bya// des ni rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byas/ phyogs bcu'i sems can btson rar bcug las bton// 'khor bsgyur la bkod de bas gang zhig gis// byang sems lta 'dod dad dang bsngags pa brjod// de ni de bas bsod nams grangs med gsungs// gsung rab rgya mtsho mang du mthong zhing thos// 'di na dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar dang*/
